title: Remote Part-Time Bookkeeper / Financial Administrator
description:
We are a growing handyman, remodeling, and home-services company looking for a part-time remote bookkeeper/financial administrator to help us build a more organized and scalable financial system.



This is a low-hour, flexible position and would be ideal for an experienced bookkeeper who already works with other clients. Hours will fluctuate throughout the month, with heavier workloads around month-end/month-start and lighter workloads during other weeks.



Expected workload: Approximately 15–25 hours per month after onboarding. The initial setup/cleanup period may require additional hours.



Responsibilities will include bookkeeping and transaction categorization, bank and credit-card reconciliation, accounts receivable and payable tracking, receipt and vendor documentation, subcontractor/W-9 tracking, job costing, estimated-vs.-actual project analysis, payroll/labor-cost review, monthly financial reporting, and identifying financial discrepancies or areas where the company may be losing margin.



A major focus of this position will be job profitability. We want to understand the true labor, material, subcontractor, and miscellaneous costs associated with individual projects so that we can improve estimating and pricing as the company grows.

The ideal candidate has experience with quickbooks, construction, remodeling, field-service, or trades-based businesses. Experience with Jobber is a plus.



Our goal is to create a system where the bookkeeper can independently access and organize the majority of the information needed without requiring constant communication with the owner. Questions and exceptions will generally be consolidated for a short weekly review rather than handled through daily interruptions.



This role has the potential to grow as the company continues to expand, but we specifically need someone who is comfortable with relatively low and fluctuating hours at the beginning.

title: Content & Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role

Innovate Well Group is seeking a creative and strategic Content & Social Media Manager to manage content production and social media across IWG and affiliated brands, with an initial focus on Innovate Well Group and Home Is Moving.

Home Is Moving is a storytelling platform exploring motherhood, travel, living abroad, identity, family, belonging, and the experience of continuing to become throughout adulthood.

The Content & Social Media Manager will be responsible for transforming ideas and written content into engaging digital assets and ensuring content moves consistently from concept to publication.

This role requires more than posting finished content. IWG is seeking someone who can identify opportunities, manage an editorial calendar, create strong visual and video content, repurpose existing material, and increasingly manage routine publishing independently.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain content calendars in collaboration with the Writer & Editorial Partner

• Transform long form writing and thought leadership into social media content

• Create graphics, carousels, short form videos, Reels, and other digital assets

• Edit video and audio content for digital platforms

• Draft or adapt short form captions as appropriate

• Schedule and publish content across selected platforms

• Maintain an organized library of photos, videos, graphics, templates, and other digital assets

• Identify opportunities to repurpose existing content across platforms and formats

• Recommend content ideas and formats based on brand priorities, audience interests, and performance

• Maintain consistency across visual presentation, messaging, and brand voice

• Monitor engagement and content performance

• Provide periodic insights and recommendations based on content analytics

• Coordinate directly with the Writer & Editorial Partner to move content efficiently from idea to publication

Autonomy and Ownership

During the initial onboarding period, content will be reviewed collaboratively while brand standards, voice, visual direction, and publishing processes are established.

The expectation is not for every post to require ongoing approval.

As trust and systems are established, the Content & Social Media Manager will have increasing ownership of routine content creation, scheduling, and publication within established brand and editorial guidelines.

The ideal candidate will proactively identify opportunities and make recommendations rather than waiting for every content idea to be assigned.

Qualifications

• Experience managing social media for organizations, founders, thought leaders, consultants, or personal brands

• Strong portfolio demonstrating graphics, carousels, video, and social media content

• Strong understanding of storytelling and audience engagement

• Experience with Canva and video editing tools

• Ability to translate one idea into multiple pieces of platform appropriate content

• Strong visual and editorial judgment

• Understanding of content analytics and ability to translate performance into practical recommendations

• Strong organizational skills and experience managing editorial or publishing calendars

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

• Interest in both professional thought leadership and personal storytelling

Success in This Role

Success means IWG and its affiliated brands maintain a thoughtful, recognizable, and consistent digital presence without requiring the Founder to personally manage every stage of content production.

Strong ideas are captured and repurposed effectively. Content is published consistently. Digital assets remain organized. Performance informs future strategy.

The Founder should increasingly be able to focus on providing expertise, stories, ideas, and on camera presence while the content team manages the process of turning those inputs into finished content.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a Customer Service Representative to serve as a key point of contact for customers, vendors, subcontractors, and other business contacts.



This role is heavily focused on professional phone communication, outbound calling, follow-up, and relationship-building. You will make and receive calls, communicate information clearly, gather the necessary details, and ensure requests and conversations are followed through to completion.



The ideal candidate is confident on the phone, easy to understand, personable, proactive, and comfortable working independently. This person should be able to build rapport quickly without sounding scripted and represent the company professionally in every interaction.



Key Responsibilities

Handle inbound and outbound calls with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and other business contacts

Make outbound calls to subcontractors and business contacts to introduce opportunities and gather information

Clearly explain the purpose of each call and communicate company information in a natural, conversational manner

Build rapport and establish trust quickly, particularly during outbound calls

Collect and accurately document contact information,
 addresses, availability, pricing, scope-related information, and other required details

Respond to customer, vendor, and subcontractor questions by phone and

Follow up consistently on requests, questions, scheduling, documents, pricing, and other outstanding items

Monitor incoming
s and ensure timely, professional responses

Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, requests, contacts, and follow-ups

Handle routine questions and issues independently and escalate matters when appropriate

Keep the owner informed of important issues, updates, opportunities, and unresolved matters

Develop a strong working knowledge of the company's processes, services, common questions, and day-to-day operations

Use provided scripts, talking points, and processes as guides while keeping conversations natural and personalized

Use Hubstaff to accurately track working hours and maintain required time-tracking and productivity records

Remain available and responsive during scheduled working hours

Perform other customer service and administrative duties as needed



Requirements

Excellent spoken and written English

Clear, easy-to-understand speech and strong verbal communication skills

Confident, professional, and personable phone presence

Comfortable making frequent outbound calls

Strong listening and comprehension skills

Ability to explain information clearly and adjust communication based on the person being contacted

Strong rapport-building and interpersonal skills

Strong organization, follow-up, and attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple conversations, requests, and follow-ups

Proactive, dependable, and able to work independently

Strong problem-solving and judgment skills

Comfortable learning new systems, processes, and industry terminology

Comfortable working remotely and adapting to new tools, workflows, and client processes

Reliable equipment and a professional-quality headset and internet connection

Willingness to use Hubstaff consistently during working hours in accordance with company and client requirements

Strong commitment to the role, schedule, and assigned responsibilities



Preferred Qualifications

Previous customer service, call-handling, or outbound calling experience

Experience communicating with vendors, subcontractors, suppliers, or other business contacts

Experience supporting a U.S.-based company

Experience with phone systems or cloud-based dialers

Experience working with Hubstaff or similar time-tracking/productivity platforms

Construction or contractor industry experience is a plus, but not required

Conversational Spanish is a plus, but not required



Candidate Evaluation Areas



Candidates may be evaluated based on the following:



Relevant Work Experience – Demonstrated experience relevant to customer service, phone handling, outbound calling, or administrative support

Software & Technical Proficiency – Ability to use common business software, communication platforms, phone systems, and other required tools

Remote Work Experience & Adaptability – Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and adapt to different clients, systems, and processes

English Proficiency (Spoken & Written) – Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently in English

Professionalism & Attitude – Professional demeanor, positive attitude, maturity, and ability to represent the client appropriately

Response Time & Clarity – Responsiveness and ability to provide clear, concise, and understandable communication

Internet & Work Setup – Reliable internet, appropriate equipment, professional workspace, and call-ready setup

Commitment to Role & Availability – Ability to consistently meet the required schedule and remain available during working hours

Time Management & Dependability – Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, follow through, and reliably manage assigned responsibilities

Problem-Solving Skills – Ability to assess routine issues, determine appropriate next steps, and escalate matters when necessary

Willingness to Learn & Adapt – Ability and willingness to learn the client's business, industry terminology, systems, and processes



What Success Looks Like



The ideal candidate will become a dependable first point of contact for the business, someone who can confidently pick up the phone, have a natural conversation, communicate information clearly, build trust quickly, gather the right information, and consistently follow through.



Success in this role is not about simply reading a script. It's about being understood, sounding confident and professional, making the person on the other end comfortable, and moving the conversation toward the desired outcome.



The right person will be able to take ownership of routine communication so the owner can stay focused on higher-value business activities without having to manage every call, question, or follow-up.

title: Video Editor for Live Events — Event Recaps & Social Content (DaVinci Resolve Preferred, AI-Forward Workflow)
description:
# Video Editor for Live Events — Event Recaps & Social Content (DaVinci Resolve Preferred, AI-Forward Workflow)



**Type of work:** Project-based (per event)

**Hours per week:** Varies with event schedule — typically 10–30 hours during active projects

**Compensation:** $900–$1,200/month USD at typical event volume, paid per event package, based on experience



**Starting immediately:** The first project for this role is a wedding film ready to go into edit now, so the right hire steps straight into paid work. Ongoing work after that is event, nonprofit, and mission-driven production. Details below.



---



**IMPORTANT: Start your application with the code word STORYLINE so we know you read this in full. Applications without the code word will not be reviewed.**



---



## A Note From Our Founder



Our productions tell stories that matter, nonprofits, mission-driven organizations, conferences that move people. We need a video editor who understands that the edit is where those stories either land or get lost. If you care about craft, deadlines are non-negotiable for you, and you get genuinely excited about new tools instead of threatened by them, this is your seat.



— Artem Nikulkov, Founder



## Who We Are



Earth Coast Productions is a Colorado-based live events and media production company with 15 years of experience. We specialize in live broadcasting, livestreaming, and full AV production for nonprofits, mission-driven organizations, and B-Corps. Every production we deliver is built around one idea: the content from a single event should fuel a brand's story for months.



## Your First Project



The first project you'll take on in this role is a wedding film. It's ready to go into edit now, with multi-camera footage from the ceremony and reception and field-flagged selects. Weddings aren't the core of what we do (our regular work is live events, nonprofits, and mission-driven productions) but this one landed on our slate and it's a solid test of fit before you move into the ongoing event work.



## How We Work



**Editing at ECP starts with emotion, not footage.** Before the first cut, our editors name the emotion the piece needs to produce, and every select, trim, and pacing decision gets tested against it. Setup grounds the viewer, the emotional core carries the runtime, the meaning lands the close. A technically clean cut with dead energy loses to a slightly looser one that is alive, and a pause that is doing emotional work is content, not dead air. We have written SOPs built around this philosophy, and you will be trained on them. If this way of thinking about the edit resonates with you, you will fit here.



We are also an AI-forward shop, and this is not a buzzword for us. It's how the pipeline actually runs. We already use tools like Claude Code, OpusClip, and Eddie AI in our workflow, and as new AI-native video tools come online, we WILL fold them into our process. You do not need to know every tool on day one. You do need to be curious, adaptable, and quick to learn. The editor who thrives here is the one who asks "what can this do for the edit?" instead of "why are we changing things again?"



We edit in DaVinci Resolve, and we give preference to editors who do too. Strong Premiere editors willing to work in Resolve will be considered, but Resolve-native applicants go to the top of the pile.



## What You Will Actually Do



- Edit event recap videos (5–15 minutes) from raw multi-camera footage

- Cut 90-second highlight reels for post-event delivery

- Edit documentary-style interview and testimonial pieces from field-flagged selects. Our crews hand off footage with flagged sound bites, multiple takes, and a named target emotion, so you build from organized material, not a raw drive

- Turn each event into a full social content package: vertical clips and reels for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Add captions, subtitles, motion graphics, lower thirds, and text overlays

- Repurpose keynote moments, speaker soundbites, and audience reactions into platform-native short-form content

- Learn and adopt new AI-native editing tools as we integrate them into the pipeline

- Manage file organization and delivery through our cloud system

- Flag footage issues or missing assets before the edit begins

- Communicate proactively on deadlines and deliverable timelines



## What Success Looks Like



- Recap videos delivered within 5 business days of the event

- Highlight reels delivered within 2 weeks of the event

- A complete social clip package (8–12 clips) delivered per event

- Every piece produces its intended emotion and meets ECP's visual and storytelling standard

- New tools in our stack are picked up and put to work, not avoided

- Zero missed deadlines without prior communication

- Proactive communication on every project



## What We Are Looking For



**Required:**



- 2 or more years of professional video editing experience

- Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred. Resolve editors will be given preference over any other NLE

- Proven short-form / social video editing experience (reels, Shorts, TikTok-style cuts, vertical formats)

- Genuine curiosity about AI editing tools and demonstrated willingness to adopt new workflows

- Experience editing event, corporate, or nonprofit video content

- You edit for emotion first: strong instincts for pacing, storytelling, hooks, and what stops the scroll

- Excellent written English

- A modern editing workstation, latest Apple Silicon (M3/M4 or newer) strongly preferred

- At least 10 TB of available storage for project media

- Reliable high-speed internet capable of handling large multi-camera footage transfers



**Nice to have:**



- Wedding editing experience (helpful for the first project, not required)

- Documentary, testimonial, or interview-driven editing experience

- Hands-on experience with AI editing tools (e.g., OpusClip, Eddie AI, Descript, CapCut AI features, or similar)

- Fusion or After Effects motion graphics experience beyond basic templates

- Experience with generative AI video tools such as Runway or Firefly

- Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management tools



## What We Offer



- Competitive per-project rates, reviewed as event volume grows

- Fully remote and async-first work environment

- A front-row seat to an AI-native production pipeline. You will learn tools here most editors have not touched yet

- Direct collaboration with the founder and production team

- Real creative work supporting mission-driven organizations

- Consistent, recurring project flow, not one-off gigs, as ECP's production volume increases



## Red Flags — Do Not Apply If...



- You have never edited event or live production footage

- You have never cut vertical or short-form social content

- You are resistant to AI tools or prefer to keep editing the way you have always done it

- You cut for technical polish while the emotion falls flat

- Your current setup cannot handle multi-camera 4K timelines or store full event archives

- You miss deadlines without communicating ahead of time

- You need constant direction and do not take initiative

- You struggle with feedback or do not iterate quickly

- You are not comfortable working async and independently

title: Executive Operations & Project Manager
description:
About the Role: Innovate Well Group is seeking an experienced Executive Operations & Project Manager to provide high level operational, administrative, and project management support across the firm. This is not a traditional virtual assistant role.

The Executive Operations & Project Manager will serve as an operational partner to IWG's Founder and CEO while helping coordinate client engagements, internal operations, business development activities, contractors, and special projects.

The ideal candidate is someone who can take an intended outcome, determine what needs to happen next, and independently move the work forward.

During the initial onboarding period, the Executive Operations & Project Manager will work closely with the leadership to learn IWG's clients, priorities, systems, and working preferences. As trust and systems are established, the role will operate with increasing independence and decision making authority.

Executive and Administrative Operations

• Support inbox management, including prioritizing messages, tracking follow ups, drafting routine correspondence, and identifying matters requiring the Founder's attention

• Manage scheduling, meeting coordination, calendar logistics, and travel arrangements as needed

• Prepare meeting materials, agendas, background information, and outstanding decisions

• Create, format, and maintain Excel spreadsheets, trackers, presentations, documents, and other business materials

• Maintain organized client, project, business development, and internal files

• Enter and maintain client, contact, project, and business information across IWG systems

Project and Client Management

• Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, deliverables, action items, and deadlines

• Coordinate behind the scenes activities for client engagements

• Follow up with clients, consultants, vendors, and partners to keep projects moving

• Translate meetings and decisions into clear next steps and assignments

• Track outstanding decisions and proactively identify risks, delays, and competing priorities

• Conduct research and organize information needed for client engagements and internal projects

• Prepare concise project updates identifying what is moving, what is pending, and where decisions are required

Convenings and Event Coordination

• Coordinate logistics for client convenings, retreats, meetings, and events

• Research venues and vendors based on established requirements

• Conduct outreach, obtain proposals, follow up with vendors, and organize responses

• Develop comparison tools and recommendations to support decision making

• Coordinate attendee information, materials, schedules, vendors, and other event logistics

• Serve as an operational point of contact with venues, vendors, and partners

Team Coordination

• Coordinate workflow across IWG's part time team members, consultants, and contractors

• Track assignments, deadlines, dependencies, and deliverables

• Follow up on outstanding work and help ensure team members have the information needed to complete assignments

• Support onboarding and coordination of new contractors and team members

• Help establish and document repeatable internal processes as the firm grows

Business Development Support

• Maintain IWG's opportunity and relationship pipeline

• Research prospective clients, partners, opportunities, and organizations

• Coordinate proposal timelines and submission requirements

• Gather and organize capability statements, biographies, past performance information, templates, and supporting materials

• Support proposal preparation, formatting, submission, and follow up

How This Role Operates

IWG values ownership, judgment, initiative, and follow through.

Team members are expected to bring solutions and recommendations whenever possible rather than simply identifying tasks that need to be completed.

For example, rather than asking whether venues should be contacted for an upcoming convening, the Executive Operations & Project Manager should be comfortable researching appropriate venues, conducting outreach, tracking responses, narrowing the options, and presenting a concise comparison and recommendation when a decision is required.

Not every decision needs to move through the Founder.

As the Executive Operations & Project Manager develops an understanding of IWG's standards and operating preferences, established processes and routine decisions should increasingly be managed independently.

Qualifications

• Experience supporting an executive, founder, consulting firm, nonprofit, or small organization

• Strong project management and organizational skills

• Advanced proficiency with Excel and confidence creating useful spreadsheets, trackers, and data summaries

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Experience coordinating projects involving multiple stakeholders

• Ability to communicate professionally with clients, vendors, consultants, and partners

• Strong research and problem solving skills

• Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the larger objective

• Sound judgment and the ability to determine when an issue can be resolved independently and when escalation is appropriate

• Comfort working in a growing organization where priorities may evolve

• Ability to handle confidential client and organizational information with discretion

Success in This Role

Success means IWG's projects, internal operations, and client engagements continue moving without requiring the Founder to personally manage every administrative or operational detail.

Information is organized. Follow ups happen. Deadlines are visible. Contractors understand their responsibilities. Client logistics are managed professionally. Decisions that require the Founder are presented clearly and efficiently.

Ultimately, this role creates greater capacity for IWG's Founder to focus on client relationships, strategy, business development, facilitation, thought leadership, and the continued growth of the firm.

title: Writer & Editorial Partner
description:
About the Role

Innovate Well Group is seeking a thoughtful and highly skilled Writer & Editorial Partner who can transform ideas, conversations, experiences, notes, and voice recordings into compelling written content.

The initial focus will be Home Is Moving and thought leadership for Innovate Well Group.

Home Is Moving explores motherhood, travel, living abroad, identity, family, belonging, and what it means to continue becoming while raising a family.

IWG's thought leadership explores organizational capacity, operations, leadership, workforce, systems, consulting, and the infrastructure that allows mission driven organizations to thrive.

This role requires more than technically strong writing. The Writer & Editorial Partner must be able to listen closely, recognize the story or insight within an idea, and capture the Founder's natural voice without replacing it with their own.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and draft Home Is Moving Substack essays based on interviews, conversations, notes, voice recordings, experiences, and ideas

• Edit and strengthen existing drafts while maintaining the author's natural voice

• Conduct periodic interviews with the Founder to capture stories, observations, lessons, and emerging ideas

• Identify potential stories and themes within conversations and everyday experiences

• Develop thought leadership content for Innovate Well Group

• Draft social media copy and other supporting written content

• Help develop and maintain editorial calendars

• Maintain and continuously refine voice and editorial guidelines for each brand

• Conduct research when additional context or supporting information is needed

• Collaborate directly with the Content & Social Media Manager to identify opportunities to repurpose longer written content

• Maintain a pipeline of future story and content ideas

• Help establish repeatable editorial systems that allow content to move efficiently from idea to publication

Editorial Approach

Assignments may begin with a developed idea, an incomplete draft, a short conversation, or a voice recording about an experience or observation.

The Writer & Editorial Partner should be able to recognize when there is a larger story inside the initial idea and ask thoughtful questions that bring that story forward.

During the initial onboarding period, drafts will be reviewed closely to establish voice, editorial standards, personal boundaries, and expectations.

As trust develops, the Writer & Editorial Partner will assume increasing ownership of the editorial process. Established content should eventually be able to move from idea through drafting, editing, and publication with significantly less Founder involvement.

The objective is not to manufacture a polished version of someone's voice. The objective is to preserve the perspective, personality, and humanity behind the writing while creating the capacity to publish more consistently.

Qualifications

• Exceptional writing and editing skills

• Demonstrated ability to capture another person's voice

• Experience interviewing individuals and translating conversations into written stories

• Strong understanding of personal essays and narrative storytelling

• Ability to write clear, compelling professional thought leadership

• Ability to move comfortably between personal storytelling and business content

• Strong editorial judgment

• Ability to work effectively with voice recordings, rough notes, incomplete ideas, and early drafts

• Curiosity and the ability to ask thoughtful questions

• Strong organizational skills and ability to independently manage assignments and deadlines

• High level of discretion when working with personal stories and confidential information

Success in This Role

Success means strong ideas no longer disappear because there was not enough time to turn them into finished writing.

Home Is Moving publishes consistently while retaining an authentic and recognizable voice. Innovate Well Group develops a stronger body of original thought leadership. It captures conversations, experiences, and observations and develops them into meaningful content.

Most importantly, the finished writing should continue to sound and feel like the person behind it.

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist – AI-Driven (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience, don't just answer tickets. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring someone to run point on resolution quality and the AI workflow behind it.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket, catch what the process and the AI miss, and treat the customer experience like it's yours. This is an individual contributor role, not a task-only one. Do it well and a bigger one opens up.



We're not a traditional support team stacking human review on top of every ticket. Our AI agent resolves most tickets on its own, and this role exists to make it smarter, not to double-check it.



What You'll Own



* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates to you: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 2+ years in e-commerce customer support, with a specific example of something you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Hands-on experience with an AI system that takes action on tickets, not a writing assistant like ChatGPT. You trust a well-trained AI's output over manually re-verifying it against the source system, and when it's wrong, you know how to fix its guidance instead of working around it.

* Comfortable without SOPs or step-by-step checklists. We operate on principles, not scripts. If you need a checklist to feel confident doing the job, this isn't the role.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM (Next day) Manila time (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break). Rest days Sunday to Monday.



Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved.

* You believe every order or tracking detail needs a human double-check before it reaches a customer, no matter what the AI already verified.



How We Hire

This application takes real thought, and that's on purpose. Low-effort or AI-generated answers won't advance, and we respect your time enough to tell you that up front.



1. Answer our application questions properly.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview on experience and fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

5. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



Full-Time Perks (after a 1 to 2 month probation)



* 13th-month pay

* 18+ days of paid time off

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

* Health insurance (HMO)

* An annual training and learning budget

* The option to fly out and meet the rest of the team



We genuinely take care of our team and invest heavily in our people. We want someone who takes ownership, grows with us, and builds something meaningful for the long term.

description:
Job Description



Get Rich Detailing is a marketing agency that helps car detailing businesses grow through
 and Instagram advertising. We’re hiring a confident, organized Client Onboarding Specialist to help business owners get started with our seven-day marketing free trial.



Prospects who come through our funnel can complete onboarding themselves or book a call for help. You will handle these onboarding calls, answer questions, explain how the trial works, and guide clients through the setup process.



Your goal is to make getting started easy and ensure each client completes everything our advertising team needs to launch their ads.



Responsibilities

• Answer common questions using our training materials and escalate technical issues to the appropriate team member.

• Follow up with clients who miss calls or leave onboarding incomplete.

• Keep accurate CRM notes, track onboarding progress, and communicate missing items to our team.

• Help clients who choose self-service onboarding when they get stuck.

• Coordinate the handoff and schedule the owner’s paid-service consultation when clients are ready to discuss continuing after the trial.



This position handles free trial education and onboarding. The owner handles sales calls for paid services.



Requirements



• Strong spoken and written English.

• Comfortable leading phone and video calls with U.S. business owners.

• Patient, friendly, and confident when explaining technology to beginners.

• Previous experience in customer support, client onboarding, or a similar client-facing role.

• Strong organization and consistent follow-up.

• Comfortable using CRMs, online forms, calendars, Google Meet, and screen sharing.

• Reliable internet, a clear microphone, a webcam, and a quiet workspace.

• Availability for scheduled calls during U.S. business hours.

• Willingness to learn our services and follow our onboarding process accurately.



Experience with Skool, Meta Business Suite, or a marketing agency is a plus. You do not need to build or manage advertising campaigns.



What Success Looks Like



Clients leave your calls understanding the trial and their next steps. Required onboarding items are completed promptly, follow-ups are handled consistently, and our advertising team receives clear, accurate handoffs.

# E-commerce Customer Support & Marketplace Assistant – Dutch Market



We are a growing Dutch e-commerce company selling consumer products across multiple online marketplaces, including **bol.com and Amazon**. We are looking for a reliable, proactive, and versatile **E-commerce Assistant** who can become an important part of our day-to-day operations.



We are not looking for someone who can only follow a fixed set of tasks. We are looking for someone who understands e-commerce, takes responsibility, learns quickly, and is comfortable handling different tasks when needed.



## Your main responsibilities



Your most important responsibility will be **customer service and day-to-day marketplace management**.



You will:



* Manage our customer service inbox and respond to customer
s

* Answer customer questions about our products, orders, deliveries, returns, warranties, and other issues

* Handle customer cases professionally and look for solutions

* Manage customer questions and cases on **bol.com**

* Help manage our **Amazon Seller Central** accounts

* Monitor orders, returns, customer messages, account notifications, and other marketplace issues

* Help maintain product listings and product information

## Amazon & bol.com



Experience with **Amazon Seller Central** is very important to us.



You should already understand the basics of working inside an Amazon seller account and preferably have experience with things such as:



* Managing listings

* Handling customer messages

* Orders and returns

* Account notifications

* Seller performance

Experience with **bol.com** is a big advantage. If you have strong Amazon experience but have never worked with bol.com before, that is okay as long as you are willing and able to learn it quickly.

Our customers are mainly Dutch, so a large part of the customer communication will be in **Dutch**.



You do not necessarily need to be a native Dutch speaker, but you must be comfortable working with Dutch customer messages and using translation/AI tools where necessary to write clear and professional responses.



Being able to understand the customer's problem and provide the correct solution is more important than translating everything manually.



## Social media – future opportunity

This could include:



* Preparing and publishing posts

* Writing captions

* Scheduling content

* Keeping our social media pages active

* Helping with basic community management



Social media experience is therefore a plus, but **it is not the main focus of the role right now**.



Our priorities are:



**1. Customer service**

**2. Amazon Seller Central**

**3. bol.com marketplace management**

## Who we are looking for



You are a good fit if you:



* Have previous experience working for an **e-commerce company**

* Have experience with customer service

* Are comfortable handling
s and customer complaints

* Are comfortable learning new systems and marketplaces

* Have good written English

* Are comfortable working with Dutch using translation and AI tools

* Want a position where your responsibilities can grow over time



Experience with **bol.com** is a strong advantage.



## What we offer



We are looking for someone for a **long-term position**, not just a short project.

As you learn our company and products, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibilities and grow into a broader e-commerce role.

title: AI-Native Founder Associate — Research, Creative & Digital Projects
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I'm an entrepreneur building and operating several businesses across software, fleet management, and design. I'm looking for a highly resourceful generalist who can work directly with me to turn ideas into finished work.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role.



I don't primarily need help managing my calendar, inbox, or data entry. I'm looking for someone who is excellent at using AI, research, freelancers, and digital tools to get things done.



I'll often give you an outcome rather than step-by-step instructions. Your job is to figure out the middle and bring me back high-quality work.





WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON



Projects will vary from week to week. Examples include:



- Developing initial branding and creative concepts using AI

- Researching companies, competitors, markets, products, and business ideas

- Finding and evaluating freelancers on Fiverr or Upwork

- Writing creative briefs and managing freelancers through completion

- Researching visual references and creating moodboards

- Helping take websites from idea to research to copy to design to launch

- Drafting and refining website copy with AI

- Creating presentations, documents, and business materials

- Sourcing and screening potential contractors

- QA testing websites and digital products

- Organizing information into useful deliverables

- Comparing software, vendors, and tools

- Managing small digital projects from beginning to completion

- Solving unfamiliar problems using AI and online resources



You do not need to personally be an expert designer, developer, copywriter, or researcher.



You need to be good at figuring out how to get things done.



Sometimes you'll do the work yourself.



Sometimes you'll use AI.



Sometimes you'll find and manage a freelancer who can do it better.





EXAMPLE ASSIGNMENT



I might tell you:



"I'm launching a software company called OneZero. I need a simple website and brand identity. It should feel sophisticated, technical, and premium. Research the market, develop some directions, figure out how we should approach the logo, and bring me your recommendation."



I don't want to tell you every individual step.



I'd expect you to research the problem, use AI extensively, explore options, make reasonable decisions, and come back to me when you have something worth reviewing.





AI IS CENTRAL TO THIS ROLE



You should already be a strong user of tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.



I expect you to use AI for:



- Research

- Brainstorming

- Writing

- Analysis

- Planning

- Creative exploration

- Critiquing your own work

- Learning unfamiliar subjects

- Problem solving



However, simply putting my request into ChatGPT and sending me the response provides very little value.



I'm looking for someone who combines:



AI + judgment + resourcefulness + execution.





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



1. Resourceful



When you don't know how to do something, your instinct is to figure it out.



2. Independent



You are comfortable making small, reversible decisions without asking for permission every time.



3. AI-Native



You know how to get substantially better results from AI than someone using basic prompts.



4. Strong Written English



You communicate clearly, naturally, and concisely.



5. Organized



You can manage several projects without losing track of details.



6. Good Judgment



You can distinguish between strong work and mediocre work, including mediocre AI-generated work.



7. Visually Competent



You don't need to be a professional designer, but you should have good taste and recognize strong branding, websites, presentations, and visual work.



8. Proactive



If you see a better way to accomplish something, I want you to tell me.





HOW WE'LL WORK



The role will start at approximately 10–15 hours per week.



Work will be primarily asynchronous.



You'll receive a queue of projects and tasks rather than waiting for me to give you something new every day.



For most projects, I want you to:



Understand the objective -> figure out the approach -> execute -> bring me the result.



If you encounter a small, reversible decision, make it.



If you encounter an important decision that genuinely requires my judgment, bring me the options and your recommendation.



The goal is for you to gradually take ownership of more projects with less oversight.





COMPENSATION



$5–8 USD/hour to start, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



There is significant opportunity for additional hours, responsibility, and compensation if the relationship works well.



I'm looking for someone who could potentially work with me for years, not someone interested in completing one short project.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words:



ONE ZERO



Then answer these five questions:



1. Tell me about a project where someone gave you an objective but you had to figure out how to accomplish it yourself. What did you do?



2. How do you currently use ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your work? Give me one specific example.



3. Imagine I tell you:



"I need a logo and simple website for a new software company called OneZero Software. It should feel sophisticated, technical, and premium."



You have a $150 budget.



Briefly explain how you would take this from idea to finished result.



4. Show me something you've personally created, researched, organized, or managed that you're proud of. Please explain what your role was.



5. What is your hourly rate, current weekly availability, and preferred working hours?



Please don't send me a generic cover letter.



I'm much more interested in seeing how you think, how you use AI, and how you approach problems you've never encountered before.

description:
Who We Are



Evo Tech Software Solutions Inc. is a highly motivated team of professionals based in Cebu, Philippines, committed to providing tailored services. With expertise in Web Development, e-Commerce Management, Data Analytics, and Graphic Design, we offer globally competitive solutions that empower our clients’ businesses to excel in today’s market.



By design, we combine your vision for your brand with our creative and technical capabilities to design the right user experience. We make sure that your customers or users discover your product not only appealing, but also useful.



Empowering your company with cutting-edge software solutions. Our skilled team adapts to tech trends, ensuring your excellence in innovation through development.



With BPO, we aim to enhance efficiency and service delivery with our versatile business support. We evolve to offer swift, improved customer service solutions.







The Opportunity

We are seeking a versatile, detail-oriented Marketplace Content & Creative Strategist to lead the development and optimization of product listings across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



This role brings together keyword research, AI-assisted content writing, graphic design, and project management to produce high-performing listing assets and brand experiences. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives at the intersection of SEO, creative development, and cross-functional coordination, and who enjoys using modern AI tools to work efficiently and creatively.



Key Responsibilities

SEO & Content Development

• Conduct advanced keyword and market research using tools such as Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar platforms.

• Write and refine product listing content (titles, bullets, descriptions) using a combination of research, brand guidelines, and AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Jasper).

• Develop structured prompts, briefs, and templates to support high-quality AI-generated content at scale.

• Ensure content accuracy, brand consistency, and marketplace compliance across all listings.



Graphic Design & Creative Production

• Create, refine, and optimize graphics for Amazon and marketplace listings, including lifestyle graphics, feature callouts, infographics, and A+ content modules.

• Use a suite of AI-enhanced design tools including:

- ChatGPT Premium for creative ideation, prompt writing, visual concepting

- Freepik Premium for assets, templates, and illustration resources

- Adobe Photoshop Generative Fill for product cleanup, scene enhancements, and creative editing

- Canva AI Upscaler for resolution improvements and design composition

- Google AI Studio for advanced generative image and asset creation

- Nano Banana AI for enhanced mockups, image variations, and visual refinements

• Translate keyword and SEO insights into effective visual storytelling and conversion-oriented design.

• Collaborate with internal team to iterate on creative assets and ensure compliance with marketplace image standards.

• Maintain high production quality across all visual assets.



Project Management & Cross-Functional Workflow

• Manage end-to-end listing optimization projects, from kickoff through final delivery.

• Coordinate with SEO, design, account management, and brand teams to keep projects on schedule.

• Use project management tools and Google Workspace and Asana to organize workflows, gather inputs, and track deliverables.

• Oversee quality assurance for both content and design before listings go live.





Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in e-commerce content strategy, listing optimization, creative production, or project management.

• Strong SEO research skills with Amazon-focused tools (e.g., Helium 10, Data Dive).

• Proven ability to manage multiple content and creative projects simultaneously.

• Experience with generative AI platforms and developing effective prompts.

• Demonstrated graphic design abilities using Photoshop, Canva, or equivalent tools.

• Excellent organization, communication, and self-editing skills

• Comfortable with Google Workspace tools and project management systems.



Nice-to-have

• Experience working with multiple brands or in an agency environment.

• Familiarity with Amazon’s image, copy, and compliance guidelines.

• Ability to review performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, rank) to inform content and creative decisions.

• Understanding of UX/UI-driven marketplace design principles.



Work Setup

• Independent Contractor - 40 hours per week

• Remote or work-from-home arrangement

• Time Schedule: US hours (8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST or night shift in PH)

• Time tracker: Time Doctor

• Observance of US Holidays (Or willingness to work during PH holidays)

• Salary - depending on the qualifications



If you’re passionate about e-commerce, creative content, and turning data-driven insights into compelling marketplace experiences, we’d love to hear from you. Join our team and play a key role in creating optimized, engaging, and high-converting product listings across leading e-commerce platforms.



You may apply through this job posting or through this company website link;

title: [URGENT] Experienced Trade Operations Administrator
description:
Are you an experienced back-office admin who already knows the ins and outs of contracting, HVAC, plumbing, or electrical operations?



We are a growing trade company looking for a Trade Operations Administrator who can jump right in without hand-holding. This is NOT an entry-level Customer Service (CSR), general VA, or fresh graduate role. We need someone who already understands US permits, field service software, and back-office trade workflows.



Job Overview

Role: Trade Operations Administrator (Back-Office Support)



Schedule: Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | US Business Hours (PH Night Shift)



Target Start Date: Immediate



What You Will Do

Permits & Utility Rebates: Take 100% ownership of end-to-end building/trade permit applications with local municipalities and track utility rebate paperwork.



Billing & Estimates: Draft, audit, and dispatch accurate job quotes, estimates, and invoices.



CRM Management: Keep customer files, job histories, and scheduling notes strictly organized in our trade CRM.



Field Crew Dispatch Prep: Clear job site documentation, customer histories, and permits so our field technicians hit the ground running every morning.



Light Marketing: Schedule simple social media updates and seasonal promo posts.



Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

1+ Years Direct US Trade Experience: Prior back-office experience supporting US trade/contracting businesses (HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Roofing, Construction, or Property Management).



Hands-on Permit Processing: Proven track record filling out, submitting, and tracking municipality trade permits.



Trade CRM Proficiency: Daily experience with platforms like ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro, or Workiz.



Self-Directed & Detail-Oriented: You do not need step-by-step supervision; you find solutions, fix record errors, and keep workflows moving.



Flawless English: Excellent written and spoken communication skills.



Bonus: Experience using modern AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to optimize your admin workflow.



How to Apply (Strictly Follow Instructions)

Generic applications, CSR-only resumes, and fresh graduate applications will be automatically rejected.



To apply, send a message with the exact subject line: SERVICE-BASED 



In the body of your message, provide:



Trade Experience Summary: A brief, 3–4 sentence summary highlighting the specific trade companies you supported, the CRM software you used, and your experience handling permits.



CV Link: A direct, working link to your updated resume (Google Drive or Dropbox link set to "Anyone with the link can view").

title: TikTok Growth VA / Short-Form Video Hunting / Edit
description:
We are looking for a creative and reliable VA to help grow 2 new TikTok accounts focused on the U.S. market.



The goal is to grow the accounts through entertaining, high-retention video short and medium content.



Responsibilities



1. Find many viral and high-potential TikTok/Reels/Shorts content that can be licensed used 



2. Find the original source whenever possible *across any other video source*



3. Check whether content can be reused through Duet, Stitch, creator permission, licensed content, or our approval process



4. Organize it by category and reaction-style videos



5. Research trending formats, style,  hooks, and or video/short topics *you have full freedom*





Requirements



Experience editing TikTok, or any other social media platform Reels, Shorts, or UGC-style content



Good understanding of video right and share licensing, hooks, pacing, and viewer retention



Make sure the same video doesn't already exist or a very  similar version exist within TikTok



Able to work independently, time flexibility and follow instructions



Bonus > Experience creating reaction or split-screen videos



Part-time



Approximately 25–30 videos per week across both accounts, with volume increasing as our templates and workflow improve.



Long-term opportunity for the right candidate



$300/month initially



2-week paid trial



Performance bonuses available as the accounts reach follower milestones



Our Goal



Build a repeatable TikTok growth system using:



viral content + split-screen videos + genuine reactions + strong hooks + follower growth



To apply, start your message with:



SPLIT SCREEN



Then send:



A short introduction



Your TikTok or TikTok Shop experience



How you normally find viral videos



How you would check whether a video can be reused



How many simple 15–45 second videos you can realistically edit in one working day?

title: Social Media Manager / Digital Marketer (2 Years above Experiences)
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

We run a group of premium coaching and performance brands, including PeakID (concierge health and performance coaching for executives and high-performing business owners) and FitPro Accelerator (a mentorship and scaling program for online fitness coaches). We are building out a world-class in-house marketing function and are hiring a full-time Social Media Manager to own our social presence across every brand and platform in the group.



This is a full-time position only. We are not looking for freelancers, side-hustlers, or anyone juggling multiple clients. We want someone who treats this as their main job and cares about doing it at the highest level.



THE ROLE

You will take full ownership of social media strategy, content, and performance across all brands in the group. You are not a poster. You are a strategist and creator who understands trends, hooks, virality, and how to build real reach and authority for premium personal brands. You think like a Gen Z native when it comes to platform behaviour and trend cycles, but you know how to translate that into content that fits a premium, high-trust brand positioning.



You will work closely with our internal edit team to get content out fast, and you will lead on strategy, planning, copy, and performance analysis yourself.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Strategy and Planning

- Design and implement a social media strategy for each brand in the group, aligned to that brand's goals, audience, and message

- Build daily, weekly, and monthly content plans across all platforms

- Research competitors and top-of-market players in our space and use those insights to shape our approach

- Scope out what world-class social media management looks like and bring that standard into our brands



Content Creation and Publishing

- Create, edit, publish, and distribute content across Instagram (feed, Stories, Reels),
 (feed and Stories), LinkedIn, YouTube and YouTube Shorts, and TikTok

- Write hooks, captions, and scripts that are built to stop the scroll and drive engagement, not just fill a content calendar

- Brief and work with our internal edit team to turn ideas into finished content quickly

- Manage and oversee all social accounts across the group day to day


 and Newsletter Marketing

- Write and manage
 marketing campaigns

- Own our weekly newsletter, including copywriting and design coordination



Performance and Optimisation

- Track and report on performance across all channels

- Bring an SEO and AI-search (AI SEO/GEO) lens to content and platform optimisation so our brands are discoverable in both traditional search and AI-driven search

- Use performance data to continually refine strategy and content



Collaboration

- Communicate and coordinate with the wider team, including the edit team, on a daily basis

- Identify and help develop JV and partnership opportunities that can extend our reach



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience managing social media for a brand, business, or personal brand at a high level, not just a portfolio of client posts

- A genuine, native understanding of current trends, hooks, virality, and platform algorithms, particularly among Gen Z and younger audiences

- Strong copywriting ability across social captions,
, and newsletters

- Comfortable creating and editing content yourself, and confident briefing and directing an edit team

- Some working knowledge of SEO and how AI search tools surface content

- Highly creative, proactive, and allergic to "just ticking the box" on content

- Excellent written English and communication skills

- Full-time availability, no other jobs, clients, or side businesses



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Growing reach, engagement, and following across all brands and platforms in the group

- A content and
 engine that runs consistently without us having to chase it

- New audiences reached that were not being reached before

- The founders spending less time on social media and marketing execution because it is fully owned and handled



HOW TO APPLY?

Copy and paste this application link into your browser:

title: Job Title: Student Success Manager
description:
Get Rich Detailing is a paid marketing agency and community for detailing business owners. We’re hiring a Student Success Manager to manage our Skool account, guide new members through onboarding, and make sure questions and requests reach the right person.



What you’ll do



Welcome new members and help free trial members complete their Skool profile and onboarding steps.



Check that members have submitted the information needed for our team to launch their ads, and follow up when something is missing.



Monitor Skool messages, comments, and posts daily. Answer routine questions clearly and promptly.



Track each free trial member’s progress. Follow up on days 5 and 6 to arrange an end-of-trial call with Caden and make sure they know what happens next.



Support paid members with questions about their services, community resources, billing, website requests, and business concerns.



Route ad questions to Fabien and growth, billing, upgrade, Google Ads, hiring, or business questions to Caden. Create a clear task in our CRM when another team member needs to take action.



Ask why a member needs a call before booking one, since many questions can be resolved by message.



Keep accurate notes so no member request or follow-up gets missed.



What we’re looking for



Excellent written English and a friendly, professional tone.



Experience supporting customers or managing an online community.



Strong organization and follow-through across multiple conversations.



Good judgment about when to answer, when to ask for more information, and when to escalate.



Comfort using Skool, a CRM, spreadsheets, and booking tools. Experience with marketing agencies or detailing businesses is a plus.

title: Lead Accountant (CPA)
description:
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Licensed CPA to join our enterprise company as a full-time bookkeeper/accountant. This is an exclusive role for someone with strong bookkeeping experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage financial records accurately and professionally.



Requirements:



• Must be a Licensed CPA

• Will be engaging as lead accountant for accounting engagements. Must have experience leading engagements and feel comfortable consulting with U.S. customers.

• Experience with QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online

• Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and journal entries

• Experience with A/P, A/R, time entry, payroll, and account reconciliations

• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal

• Ability to present, explain, and analyze financial reports

• Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

• Willing to install and use Time Doctor



Work Details:



• Full-time, exclusive role; no other jobs or side work

• 40 hours per week

• Must overlap at least 6 hours daily with PST business hours, 9 AM to 5 PM

• More overlap hours are preferred



How to apply: Please include a link to your CV and ensure it is set to public access.

title: Virtual Receptionist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Virtual Receptionist to serve as the front-line point of contact for a U.S. medical, dental, or clinical practice. This role requires someone who is comfortable speaking directly with American patients, managing appointment schedules, working inside an EHR, and supporting patient follow-up and insurance-related tasks.



The ideal candidate has hands-on U.S. healthcare front-desk experience and can independently manage patient calls, scheduling, recall/reactivation, and insurance verification.



Key Responsibilities

Answer live inbound calls from U.S. patients in a professional, friendly, and patient-focused manner.

Handle patient questions, appointment requests, cancellations, rescheduling, and general front-desk inquiries.

Book, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments directly within the practice's EHR system.

Maintain accurate patient demographics, appointment details, and other information in the EHR.

Run recall and reactivation lists, including:

Pulling the appropriate patient report/list.

Calling patients who are due for follow-up or have become inactive.

Speaking with patients about scheduling their next visit.

Rebooking patients and documenting the outcome.

Perform or assist with insurance verification for U.S. patients prior to appointments.

Collect and verify patient information required for visits.

Follow up with patients regarding appointments, paperwork, referrals, or other practice requirements.

Accurately document patient interactions and scheduling activity in the appropriate system.

Maintain patient confidentiality and follow applicable privacy and practice procedures.

Provide a professional and welcoming patient experience on every call.

Required Qualifications

Previous experience working as a front-desk receptionist, scheduler, patient coordinator, or virtual receptionist for a U.S. medical, dental, or clinical practice.

Demonstrated experience answering live inbound patient calls for a U.S. healthcare practice.

Hands-on experience booking and rescheduling patients inside an EHR.

Must be able to name the EHR system(s) used in previous healthcare roles.

Experience running a recall or reactivation workflow, including pulling a report/list, calling patients, and successfully rebooking them.

Experience performing insurance verification for a U.S. medical, dental, or clinical practice.

Strong spoken English that is clear and easily understood by American patients.

Excellent phone etiquette, listening skills, and patient communication.

Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry.

Ability to handle multiple calls, scheduling requests, and administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable working independently in a remote setting.

title: Amazon Brand Manager
description:
[READ EVERYTHING PROPERLY BEFORE APPLYING]

[Do not apply if you do not fit the requirements]

[Do not apply if you dislike time trackers]

[Do not apply if you are far from NCR and nearby provinces]

--



JOB SUMMARY:

As our Amazon Brand Manager, you'll be the one steering how our products perform on Amazon day to day — from pricing and promotions to ad campaigns and everything in between. You'll keep an eye on our listings, spot opportunities to grow revenue, and help us stay ahead in our category.





RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage daily sales operations for assigned products, including pricing, promotions, and advertising campaigns

- Oversee product listings and identify new revenue opportunities within respective categories

- Monitor product performance to drive consistent sales growth and stronger category rankings

- Conduct in-depth product analysis and research market trends/competitors to guide strategic decisions

- Collaborate with the inventory planning team to manage promotions and excess inventory

- Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality across all deliverables





QUALIFICATIONS:

• Strong brand management experience — from listing optimization and A+ Content to product launches and brand positioning

• PPC experience is a plus, but not required

• Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills

• Solid market research experience

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong documentation and time management skills





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS:

• This role is strictly for applicants based within NCR or nearby areas (e.g., Bulacan, Rizal).

• You'll need to send a portfolio with a real ASIN you've personally handled from launch to finish (brand/product can be blurred), backed by substantial data — think sales or bestseller ranking graphs, not just a screenshot. If NDA-restricted or you no longer have account access, a short video walkthrough explaining the work and results is acceptable instead.

• Be ready to walk through and explain the actual performance data behind that ASIN during the interview — conversion rate, ACOS, organic vs. paid sales split. This will be a substantial part of the conversation, so come prepared to speak to real numbers, not general claims.





SETUP:

• Full-time, 9AM to 6PM PHT

• Uses Time Doctor for time tracking

• Own equipment needed (Laptop, Mouse, Earphones/Headphones)

• Stable internet connection, with a readily available backup connection

• Full-time contractual employment (renewal contract based on performance)

• There will be quarterly (with chances of it being monthly) meet-ups within NCR whenever the CEO visits the Philippines

title: TikTok Ops Specialist
description:
[Read properly before applying]

[Do not apply if you do not meet the requirements or you do not possess the ample experience]

[This is NOT a VIDEO EDITOR job opening]

[This is NOT a CONTENT CREATOR job opening]

---



We're hiring a TikTok Operator to run and grow our U.S. TikTok Shop. This isn't a content or social media job — it's a business role. You'll own the whole channel: TikTok Shop, creators/affiliates, content, ads, livestreams, and the numbers behind all of it.



We want a builder! Someone who either launched a TikTok Shop from zero and made it succeed, or took over a shop that wasn't performing and turned it around. It needs to be *their* win — not a channel they just helped run while someone else called the shots.



You'll start hands-on, with room to build and lead a team as the channel grows.





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon, and willing to travel to NCR whenever the CEO is in Manila to check in with the team

- Was the main driver — not just a helper — behind a TikTok Shop's growth or launch. This means one of:

 [1] Launched a TikTok Shop from scratch and built it into a success (or at least got it to a strong state before leaving the company/client), or...

 [2] Took over a TikTok Shop with little to no traction (low sales/GMV) and turned it around

- Can clearly explain *their own* strategy and decisions behind that growth — not just point to results the shop achieved under someone else's plan

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

title: YOUTUBE SOCIAL MEDIA SPECIALIST
description:
YOUTUBE SOCIAL MEDIA SPECIALIST - SOCIAL MEDIA DEPARTMENT



JUSTSIMPLY MARKETING (JSM) is a fast-scaling digital marketing agency helping personal brands, coaches, speakers and experts build and monetize their online presence. We are fully remote and work with high-profile creators. Results over hours. Extreme ownership. Fast decisions, zero bureaucracy.



We are hiring a YouTube Social Media Specialist to own the YouTube channel strategy for our roster of personal-brand clients: long-form, Shorts, SEO and analytics, start to finish.



THIS IS FOR YOU IF

• You have grown real YouTube channels and can prove it with numbers

• You think in watch time, CTR and retention curves, not just "views"

• You can turn a founder's raw footage or ideas into a channel that compounds

• You want ownership of a channel, not a checklist of tasks



THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

• You have only run Instagram or TikTok and are hoping YouTube transfers over

• You need heavy oversight to hit a publishing calendar

• You are not comfortable being measured on subscriber growth and watch time



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own YouTube end to end for assigned client channels: long-form, Shorts, SEO and analytics

• Optimize titles, descriptions, tags and thumbnails to maximize reach and algorithmic pickup

• Build and execute strategies to grow subscribers, watch time and overall channel performance

• Track YouTube trends, platform changes and tools, and apply them fast

• Report on channel performance and translate data into next steps

• Collaborate with Video Editors and Scriptwriters on repurposing long-form into Shorts and vertical content

• Work with Thumbnail Designers to test and improve click-through rate

• Coordinate with the Social Media Manager on content calendars and cross-platform strategy



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven track record growing YouTube channels, with specific success stories

• Portfolio and analytics that back up your results (screenshots, channel links, or case studies)

• Experience working with creators or brands on measurable growth, not just posting

• Analytical and data-driven, with a creative eye for what makes people click and stay

• Comfortable in YouTube Studio daily, plus tools like VidIQ or TubeBuddy, Canva, Google Sheets/Docs



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRMs supporting funnels

• Familiarity with AI tools for keyword research, scripting or transcription

• Exposure to Threads, Instagram Reels or TikTok for cross-platform repurposing



FIRST 90 DAYS SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Consistent publishing cadence hit with zero missed uploads

• Measurable lift in watch time and average view duration across owned channels

• Thumbnail and title testing producing a clear CTR improvement

• Clean, on-time performance reporting each week



HOURS AND JOB TYPE

Remote, open worldwide. Standard working hours are 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM EST, Monday to Friday.



WHO YOU WORK WITH

You report to the Social Media Team Managers. You will work closely with Video Editors, Scriptwriters and Thumbnail Designers to bring channels to life, and coordinate with Social Media Specialists on overall content strategy.



TOOLS

YouTube Studio, VidIQ or TubeBuddy, 
, Slack, Google Drive/Docs/Sheets, Metricool, Canva.

Apply only through the JSM application form:
