title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.

title: Digital Operations Assistant
description:
Location: Fully Remote

Position: Full-time, freelance

Working hours: 8 hours per day, 5–6 days per week



We’re looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Digital Operations Assistant to support our team with a variety of online and administrative activities.



The position involves working with digital information, online resources, internal systems, and recurring workflows. You’ll be given established procedures and clear priorities, while also being expected to manage your assigned work independently and communicate when something requires attention.



This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys structured computer-based work, pays close attention to details, and is comfortable learning new tools and processes.



What You'll Do



Your responsibilities may include:



Digital & Administrative Tasks



Working with spreadsheets, online platforms, internal tools, and shared resources

Organizing information and maintaining internal records when required

Preparing simple reports, lists, or summaries

Updating operational documentation when procedures change

Performing basic research to support specific assignments

Preparing or organizing digital materials when needed

Assisting team members with ad hoc administrative and online tasks



Operational Support



Carrying out recurring operational workflows based on established procedures

Managing assigned tasks from initial instruction through completion

Keeping track of outstanding work and ensuring deadlines are met

Reviewing task requirements before beginning an assignment

Following up on incomplete or unclear items when necessary

Maintaining internal operational resources and documentation

Supporting the implementation of updated procedures and workflows

Assisting with new projects and other operational priorities as they arise



Quality & Process Checks



Reviewing completed work to ensure it meets established requirements

Identifying errors, inconsistencies, or unusual cases

Making straightforward corrections when appropriate

Escalating issues that require additional information or a management decision

Performing recurring checks on assigned processes and resources

Helping identify recurring problems or areas where a workflow could be improved

Recording relevant issues and observations for supervisors



Project & Team Support



Taking responsibility for individual assignments or small projects

Providing progress updates on ongoing work

Communicating delays, questions, or potential problems in a timely manner

Helping test new workflows or tools before they are introduced more broadly

Supporting supervisors with additional tasks as business priorities develop

The exact combination of responsibilities will vary depending on current projects and operational needs.



What Makes You a Good Fit:



English language proficiency (both verbal and written) 

Working knowledge of Google Workspace apps (Docs, Sheets, Drive, etc.)

Strong research skills

Diligent and dedicated work ethic

Ability to complete tasks efficiently and accurately while adhering to time constraints

Comfortable spending most of your workday working at a computer (8 hours or more if needed)

Ability to manage deadlines effectively and comfortable using productivity-tracking tools 



Essential Setup



Reliable computer or laptop

Stable internet connection

Ability to work comfortably with multiple online platforms and browser-based tools



What You Can Expect:



Working schedule: This is a completely remote, full-time position requiring 8 working hours per day. We are ideally looking for someone available to work 6 days per week (Monday–Saturday), though a 5-day workweek (Monday–Friday) can also be accommodated.



Our team primarily operates in the CET time zone. However, we offer flexibility regarding your working hours, which can be agreed upon with management based on your availability and the team's needs.



Please note that the 8-hour workday should be completed in one continuous working period, with regular breaks as needed. Working hours can’t be split into separate periods throughout the day.



Contract: As this is a freelance position, you’ll work under a freelance contract. Please note that, unlike a standard employment contract, this arrangement doesn’t include employee benefits or employer-provided contributions such as taxes, social security, or insurance.



Time Off: Time away from work can be arranged in advance with management, subject to the team's workload and operational requirements. Approved time off is unpaid.



Compensation: The starting hourly rate is $3, with estimated monthly earnings of $520–$620, depending on the agreed-upon work schedule.



Please note that, as this is a freelance position, compensation is calculated and paid on an hourly basis rather than as a fixed monthly salary. Payments are monthly.



We also regularly review our team members’ rates based on their performance, reliability, and overall contribution to the team, with opportunities for rate increases and growth over time.



What’s Next?



Selected candidates will begin with a one-month trial period.



During this period, you will receive detailed guidance on our systems, procedures, and expectations. As you become familiar with the work, you will gradually take greater responsibility for your assigned tasks.



Recruitment Process



The selection process includes:



A short initial questionnaire

Two short practical assessments

Interview



The assessments are designed to evaluate skills relevant to the position and are used solely for recruitment purposes. They aren’t part of our regular business operations and are therefore unpaid. Successful candidates will be invited for an interview.



Only candidates who meet the initial requirements will be contacted regarding the first recruitment stage.



Interested?



If you are organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently with digital information, we'd be happy to hear from you.

title: QA Engineer - Guardis
description:
About Guardis



Guardis is a multi-chain trading and intelligence platform supporting Solana and Robinhood Chain. We process on-chain data in real time to surface smart-money flows, flag rugs and fraud before they hit traders, and deliver live analytics through our app and an enterprise API used by other businesses.



When our data is wrong or late, people lose money. That makes quality a core product feature, not an afterthought.



The role



We're growing our QA team and hiring a second QA Engineer. You'll work alongside our existing QA engineer to expand test coverage as the product scales across chains, strengthen our automation, and raise the bar on data correctness. You'll own significant areas of the product end to end and have a real say in how we test and release.



What you'll do



Own testing for major product areas, with a particular focus on our multi-chain expansion

Test our enterprise REST API for correctness, reliability, performance and error handling across both Solana and Robinhood Chain data

Verify that the data we serve is actually right, by reconciling it against on-chain sources and building checks that catch drift

Test that features behave consistently across chains, while catching chain-specific differences in transactions, wallets, tokens and data formats

Test real-time features delivered over WebSockets, including live price feeds, reconnection behaviour, and performance on mobile networks

Extend and maintain our automated test suites for web, mobile and API, and keep them fast and reliable in CI/CD

Add quality checks to our data pipelines so problems are caught before users see them

Test campaign features such as leaderboards, quests and referral tracking, including thinking like someone trying to game them

Run load and performance testing ahead of major launches

Work with engineers and the wider QA team to reproduce, triage and prioritise issues, and push back clearly when something isn't ready



What we're looking for



3+ years in QA or test engineering, with meaningful hands-on automation experience

Strong API testing skills, with experience in tools like Postman, pytest, or similar

Experience with a modern automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, Appium, Detox or Maestro

Comfort writing test code in Python, TypeScript or JavaScript

An understanding of how to test data-heavy or real-time systems where the "correct" answer changes constantly

Solid SQL skills, enough to query and validate data independently

A risk-based mindset: you prioritise what matters to users rather than aiming for 100% coverage of everything

Clear, direct communication and the confidence to hold your ground on quality



Nice to have



Experience in crypto, DeFi, trading, fintech or payments

Familiarity with Solana and/or EVM chains, particularly Ethereum L2s or the Arbitrum ecosystem

Experience testing products that support multiple blockchains

Familiarity with wallets, on-chain data and block explorers

Experience testing WebSocket or streaming systems

Load testing experience with k6, Locust or similar

Exposure to analytical databases such as ClickHouse or TimescaleDB



Why join



Ownership of real product areas in a growing QA team, with room to shape how we work as we scale

Hard, interesting problems at the intersection of real-time data, finance, security and multi-chain infrastructure

A small, fast-moving team where your work ships quickly and matters visibly.

title: Virtual Assistant (Part-Time) – Product Sourcing — Immediate Start — Multiple Vacancies Available!
description:
About us

We're a growing UK property management company. We regularly need parts, materials and contractors sourced at the best price. We're building a pool of reliable VAs to help with this on a flexible, ad-hoc basis.



How it works



-You will be part of our sourcing group.

-When we need something sourced, we post the request. The first VA to reply "mine" gets the job.

-You do the sourcing, log everything in our shared sheet, and get paid weekly by bank transfer.

-There are no fixed shifts and no minimum. You work on the jobs you want, when you're available.



Hours

Fully flexible, part-time and ad-hoc. Requests mostly arrive during UK business hours (about 8am-6pm UK time, which is roughly 3-4pm to 1-2am Philippine time). Fast responses get you more jobs.



What you'll do



-Compare prices for single parts, and full lists of parts, on price and delivery time

-Find UK suppliers and get quotes by
 (large orders can involve 50+ suppliers)

-Source from China/Alibaba, and find makers for custom or hard-to-find parts

-Get estimates from contractors (painters, waste removal etc.) via WhatsApp and platforms like RatedPeople and MyBuilder

-Negotiate. When one supplier quotes lower, ask others to match or beat it. You earn a bonus based on how much you can save.



You must have



-A reliable UK VPN, so you see UK Google Shopping results and UK prices

-Amazon UK and eBay UK accounts (free), and the ability to check what's available with Amazon Prime (we have it)

-Reliable internet and a laptop or PC, and good written English

-Attention to detail (right spec, right part) and the ability to follow instructions exactly



Pay (USD, weekly bank transfer)



-Single item under £20: $0.50. £20 and over: $1.00

-Basket check: $0.50 per item, max $1.50

-Split basket: $0.50 per item (under £20) or $1.00 per item (£20+), counted per different item

-Supplier quotes: $0.50 per valid written quote, up to 20 quotes per job

-Contractor estimates: $0.30 per valid estimate, up to 50 per job

-Negotiation bonus: 10% of the money you save us, up to $20 per job, paid whenever we order at your negotiated price. This includes smart splitting of orders across suppliers.



Examples



-Get 20 supplier quotes on a roofing materials order: $10, plus a bonus if you negotiate it down

-Get 50 estimates from painters: $15, plus a bonus if you negotiate it down

-Confirm the cheapest supplier for a 10-item plumbing list: $1.50



Estimated earnings

-Active VAs can expect around $
+ per month at our current volume. There is no monthly cap. The more jobs you claim, the more quotes you collect and the more you negotiate, the more you earn, and we're growing, so volume is increasing.



As part of your application, please send your CV and also record a short video answering the following questions:



1. What is your experience with sourcing and price comparison?

2. Example. How would you get us the best price on a waste removal job for 1 tonne of hard rubble?

title: Content Manager | $900+ monthly, Long-term, Full-time, Remote
description:
**Content Manager — Dreaver (Remote)**



We're Dreaver. We sell treadmills for the home, direct to people who want to move more without a gym membership. We run creative and ads across the Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden. Right now our content lives across a Google Drive. Notion Page and
, all has grown faster than our structure has. We need someone to fix that, and then keep it fixed and even make it better where you can!



**What you'd be doing**

- Owning our Content Drive: naming, folders, versioning, all of it. Not a one-time cleanup, an ongoing system that stays usable as more content comes in every week.

- Matching content to the task that needs it. When an editor needs footage for a specific ad, you know where it is, or you know who to ask.

- Chasing people for content. Founders, UGC creators, external partners, they don't always deliver on time or in the right format. You follow up, you don't wait to be asked twice.

- Connecting UGC, content and editors so nothing sits waiting. If an editor is blocked because a clip hasn't landed yet, that's on you to catch and fix before it becomes a delay.

- Owning deadlines across the content pipeline. Not doing the editing or the shooting yourself, but making sure everyone else's can work on their parts.



**What you bring**

Google Drive fluency: real folder architecture, not "I use Drive sometimes." You've organized shared drives for a team before, not just your own files.

A tracker mind. Whether that's Asana, Notion, Sheets or something else, you default to writing things down and following up, not remembering it in your head.

Comfortable chasing busy people for deliverables without being annoying about it. You know how to write a follow-up that gets a reply.

Written English that's clear and direct. You'll be coordinating with team members and creators across NL, DK and SE markets, so you don't need to speak those languages, but you do need to communicate clearly in English with everyone in between.



**What we love to see in you**

- You're responsible for the result, not just your tasks. See something that could be better? You pick it up.

- You don't wait around. You spot opportunities, flag problems, and act.

- No unnecessary complexity. If it can be simpler, we make it simpler.



**What we offer**

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- $
monthly, depending on your skill level

- Long-term role, not a project. Perform well and you grow with us

- A few hours of overlap with Amsterdam CET, otherwise totally flexible



**How to apply**

Send your application with the subject line in exactly this format:

[Your name] | [years managing content/drive systems] | [tool you'd default to for tracking deadlines]

Example: Maria Santos | 2 | Notion



Then in the body, answer these questions and nothing else. No CV, no cover letter, links only where asked:



1. Describe a messy shared drive or content system you inherited or built. What did you change?

2. A content deliverable was late from someone outside your control. What did you actually do?

3. Link to a folder structure, tracker, or system you built (screenshot or shared view is fine).

title: Senior Amazon UK Bookkeeper & Operations Lead – Xero + Link My Books
description:
SPCR Distribution Ltd is a fast-growing UK-based eCommerce business founded three years ago. We operate primarily on Amazon UK through a wholesale and brand-direct model, alongside a smaller eBay operation.



We manage a substantial catalogue of products, supplier orders and inventory held across Amazon FBA, our warehouse and goods in transit. As the business has grown, the accuracy of our bookkeeping, inventory accounting and management reporting has become increasingly important.



We are also moving beyond traditional wholesale and developing closer commercial partnerships with brands. We work directly with brands to improve how their products are presented, managed and grown on Amazon, including taking responsibility for agreed or exclusive product ranges.



We operate with a lean team consisting of two directors, three experienced remote team members and two UK-based warehouse team members. Although this is a remote position, the successful applicant will become a permanent, full-time member of the company and will take ownership of a critical area of the business.



Part One: Finance, Bookkeeping and Management Reporting



This is the first and most important part of the position. The successful candidate will take ownership of our internal bookkeeping, financial controls and management-reporting process.



Why This Role Exists



As SPCR Distribution has grown, the complexity of our purchasing, inventory and financial reporting has increased significantly. Our current accounting and management reporting processes have not yet developed to the standard required by the business.



We are therefore looking for an experienced Amazon UK finance and bookkeeping professional who can take ownership of this area. The successful candidate must bring a proven system and way of working from previous roles, assess how our business currently operates and begin implementing a reliable reporting process immediately.



Your primary objective will be to ensure that our financial information is complete, accurate and supported by clear reconciliations. During the initial setup period, you will produce weekly management reports so that the process can be tested, discrepancies can be resolved and the directors can validate the results. Once the system is established, you will be responsible for delivering accurate monthly management accounts and profit and loss reporting consistently and on time.



This is not a beginner or junior bookkeeping position, and it is not suitable for someone who is just beginning to work with Amazon businesses, Xero or eCommerce accounting. We need someone who has already performed this work successfully and can clearly demonstrate the systems, controls and checking processes they have used to produce accurate results.



You will work closely with the directors and our existing UK accountant. You will become the internal owner of the day to day bookkeeping, reconciliations, inventory information and management reporting process, while the UK accountant will continue to provide external accounting oversight and complete the relevant statutory and compliance work.



We are not looking for someone who simply enters transactions or generates reports from accounting software. We need someone who can investigate discrepancies, challenge information that does not reconcile and explain clearly how every material figure has been calculated.



Essential Expertise and Experience



Before applying, please confirm that you have strong, practical experience in all or most of the following areas:



✓ Xero bookkeeping for a UK limited company.

✓ Amazon UK and Amazon FBA accounting, including sales, fees, refunds, reimbursements, reserves and settlement reconciliation.

✓ Link My Books or A2X. We currently use Link My Books, but we are open to considering A2X if an experienced candidate can clearly demonstrate why it would improve our accounting process.

✓ Producing accurate weekly and monthly management accounts, including profit and loss reporting. (Please send any examples)

✓ Reconciling profit and loss figures back to the balance sheet and supporting records. Producing a P&L without completing the underlying reconciliations will not be sufficient.

✓ Inventory accounting, including opening and closing stock, cost of goods sold, Amazon FBA inventory, warehouse inventory, goods in transit, work in progress and paid but not yet received stock.

✓ Correctly accounting for supplier invoices, credit notes, freight, duty, preparation costs and other landed costs.

✓ UK VAT treatment for an inventory-based Amazon and eCommerce business.

✓ Investigating and explaining the commercial reasons behind changes in financial performance. We do not simply want someone to produce numbers. You will be expected to act as our eyes and ears within the business by identifying why revenue, profit, margins, costs or inventory values have changed and explaining the underlying reasons clearly to the directors and our external accountant. This is not a basic data entry or reporting role.

✓ Excellent written and spoken English is essential. You must be able to communicate clearly and professionally with the directors, our UK accountant, suppliers and warehouse team, and explain financial or operational issues accurately. 



You must already have a reliable working system that you have successfully used in a previous role. During the application process, you will be asked to explain:



- How your system works.

- What information you require.

- How you validate the accuracy of your results.

- How you manage missing or conflicting information.

- How you create a clear audit trail.

- How your previous system could be adapted to SPCR Distribution.



Part Two: Purchasing, Order Management and Operational Control



Why This Is a Full-Time Role



We are not looking for someone to complete our bookkeeping for a few hours each month. SPCR Distribution is a growing company, and we want the successful candidate to join our team on a full-time, long-term basis.



The accuracy of our accounts depends heavily on what happens before information reaches Xero. Purchase orders, supplier invoices, stock receipts, credits, discrepancies, freight costs and Amazon shipments must all be recorded and communicated correctly.



For this reason, the successful candidate will also take ownership of our purchasing and order-management process. This will give you complete visibility of each order from the moment it is created through to the stock being received, shipped to Amazon and reflected within our financial records.



You will not be dependent on another employee passing financial information to you after an order has been completed. You will be directly involved throughout the process and will therefore be able to see:



* What was ordered.

* What was invoiced.

* What was paid.

* What was received.

* What was shipped to Amazon.

* Which credits or refunds are outstanding.

* Where quantity, cost or stock discrepancies have occurred.

* How each order should be reflected within the accounts.



This operational ownership is designed to support the finance and reporting responsibilities outlined in Part One. Nothing should be lost between purchasing, the warehouse, Amazon and Xero.



Purchasing and Order-Management Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



✓ Creating approved purchase orders within SoStocked and ensuring that the products, quantities and agreed costs are recorded correctly.



✓ Managing each order through our established ClickUp workflow from the point of ordering through to completion.



✓ Ensuring that supplier invoices, order confirmations and supporting documents are attached to the correct purchase order and are available for bookkeeping and reconciliation.



✓ Communicating with suppliers where required regarding order confirmations, shortages, delayed products, price discrepancies, credit notes, refunds and replacements.



✓ Communicating directly with our warehouse team regarding incoming orders, preparation requirements and Amazon shipments.



✓ Creating clear warehouse work orders containing the products, quantities and preparation instructions required for each shipment.



✓ Producing the required Amazon product labels and shipping labels.



✓ Creating and booking Amazon shipments, arranging courier collections and providing the warehouse with the necessary shipment documentation.



✓ Monitoring orders until completion and ensuring that quantities ordered, invoiced, received and shipped have been checked against one another.



✓ Recording and following up shortages, damaged goods, incorrect products, pricing discrepancies and outstanding supplier credits.



✓ Ensuring that completed orders are not closed until all relevant invoices, credits, stock movements and discrepancies have been resolved and recorded.



Additional Amazon and Financial Operations



The role will also include ongoing back-end responsibilities that support the accuracy of our accounts and Amazon operation:



✓ Maintaining accurate product sourcing costs and updating them when supplier prices, preparation costs, freight, duty or other landed costs change.



✓ Comparing supplier invoices against purchase orders and identifying any differences in cost or quantity.



✓ Tracking which orders have received the correct supplier credits and which discrepancies remain unresolved.



✓ Monitoring and managing eligible Amazon reimbursements for lost, damaged or incorrectly handled inventory.



✓ Checking relevant Amazon operational notifications and escalating any account-health concerns or urgent issues to the directors.



✓ Completing routine daily and weekly checks to ensure that financial and operational information remains accurate and up to date.



✓ Maintaining a clear record of unresolved issues so that missing invoices, credits, stock discrepancies or reimbursements are followed through to completion.



Systems Used



The systems used across this part of the role currently include:



* SoStocked for inventory planning and purchase orders.

* ClickUp for order management and process control.

* Amazon Seller Central for shipments, labels, inventory and reimbursements.

* Xero and Link My Books for bookkeeping and financial reporting.

* SellerToolKit for stock valuation, cost information and profitability checks.

* Orca Scan for warehouse inventory records.

* Courier and shipping portals for labels, bookings and collections.



Previous experience with every operational system listed above is not essential. Detailed SOPs have already been written for these processes, and training will be provided on our specific workflow. However, expert experience with Xero, Amazon UK and either Link My Books or A2X remains essential.



Training and Handover



Our purchasing and order-management processes are already documented through detailed SOPs. You will not be expected to design this part of the role from nothing.



An existing team member will work alongside you during the handover period, demonstrate each stage of the process and remain available while you become confident operating it independently.



You will become the primary owner of this workflow, but all information must continue to be recorded clearly within our shared systems. The process must never depend entirely on one person’s memory or private records.



The objective is for you to have complete visibility across both the operational and financial sides of the business. This will allow you to produce more accurate accounts, identify problems earlier and explain not only what has happened within the numbers, but why it has happened.



Working Hours and Employment Details



✓ This is a full-time position working Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm UK time. You must be available and actively working throughout these hours and follow UK working hours when the UK changes between GMT and British Summer Time.

✓ Salary will be paid weekly. The final salary will be agreed based on the successful candidate’s experience and proven ability.

✓ Annual leave and paid Philippine public holidays will be provided.

✓ Paid overtime may be available during busier weeks. Any overtime will be discussed and agreed in advance.

✓ This is an exclusive full-time position. You must not undertake another job or client work during your contracted SPCR Distribution working hours.

✓ Teamlogger is used by all remote team members for time tracking and working-hour visibility.

✓ You must have a reliable computer, a stable high-speed internet connection and a suitable backup plan for internet or power interruptions.

✓ We are looking for someone who can start very soon. Please confirm your earliest available start date when applying.



Finally, apologies for the length of this job post and thank you for making it all the way to the end! We wanted to be completely transparent about the position and the person we are looking for. Hopefully, we will see you soon on a Teams call.

title: AI Video Creator + Creative Strategist
description:
Leather Furniture Brand, Australian Company

Rate: 10 AUD per hour · 20 hrs/week trial, scaling to 40



About us

We are Rumpus, an Australian leather furniture brand selling lounges and sofas in Australia and the United States. We are part of a larger ecommerce group and we run paid social advertising continuously, mostly on Meta. We use AI tooling across the whole business every day.



The role

We are looking for one person who can make ads end to end for Rumpus.



End to end means you own the whole thing: you take the brief, d
 the concept, write the script, generate and edit the video, and hand back an ad we can put budget behind the same week. You are not waiting for someone else to give you a storyboard, and you are not handing the editing to someone else.



This role has two halves and we need both.



The first half is tool fluency. You are genuinely comfortable with the current generation of AI video tools: Seedance, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, Runway, and whatever comes next. You know which tool suits which job and you can explain why. You edit confidently in Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or similar.



The second half is creative strategy, and this is the half most applicants do not have. Before you open any software you should be able to say who the ad is for, what angle it is taking, and what the offer is. Format comes after all three. If you have only ever executed other people's concepts, this will be a hard role.



What you will do

- Produce Meta ad creative every week, at volume

- Concept first: persona, angle, offer, then format

- Generate, edit, grade, caption and deliver finished ads

- Review what performed, form a view on why, and feed that into the next batch

- Bring us ideas we did not ask for

- One hard constraint, please read before applying

- Our entire product claim is the leather itself. It is full grain and you can see that in real footage. AI still gets leather grain, stitching and light on a seat cushion wrong, and our customers spend thousands of dollars and look very closely before buying. So the product must be real footage.



AI is for everything around the product: scenes, environments, people, motion, concepting, variations and speed.



If your portfolio is entirely AI-generated product shots, this is not the right role for you, and we would rather both of us knew that now than after a month.



Rate, hours and timezone

- Rate: 10 AUD per hour

- Start: 20 hours per week as a paid trial

- Then: 40 hours per week once we are both happy

- This is ongoing work, not a single project

- You need some overlap with Australian business hours (GMT+10 / GMT+11)

- Stable internet and a computer that can actually handle video editing

title: Operations & Sales Support Assistant - Proactive Problem-Solver
description:
ABOUT US



We're a growing cold-calling and sales outsourcing agency, running outbound campaigns for clients across Australia, New Zealand, and other international markets. We're a small, close-knit team with a positive, low-drama atmosphere and reasonable, fair KPIs and expectations. We're not a high-pressure call-centre grind. You'd be working alongside our sales team, supporting our operations, and working directly with the founder.



THE ROLE



We're looking for someone to own the day-to-day operations side of our business so our sales team and our founder can focus on what they do best. This is not a role where you wait to be told what to do. If something's broken, blocked, or needs a decision and no one's around to ask, we want you to figure it out and act - using our systems, using your judgement, and using AI tools like Claude to help you with problems you haven't seen before.



***PLEASE NOTE - Working Hours for this job are fixed, 9 AM - 5 PM Sydney Time (which is currently 7AM - 3PM Manila/PH Time). If you CAN NOT work these hours, please DO NOT APPLY.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



-Building and cleaning prospect lists (Clay, Lead Sourcing Tools, Claude and other AI tools), and enriching company/contact data

-Setting up and managing outbound campaigns in our sales dialer (
), and contacts in our CRM (called Less Annoying CRM)

-Setting up redial campaigns and making sure they don't overlap with contacts already spoken to

-Putting together each sales rep's next-day work plan and sending it to them

-Monitoring our inbox and handling quick client requests yourself - using the CRM/dialer to find the answer rather than escalating everything

-Supporting our sales reps day-to-day (on 
) - allocating campaigns, granting access, updating campaign status, and helping troubleshoot when something's not working

-General operational admin as it comes up, and an ongoing backlog of improvement tasks for quieter stretches

-Potential online event management and recruitment help where needed (but this is for later, not now)



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The single most important thing we're looking for: you take action instead of waiting to be told. Software and our specific systems, we can teach you. What we can't teach is judgement and initiative.



Here's an example of what we mean: a client
s saying they need their campaign paused because they want to review the messaging. You don't know who's currently working that campaign, and the founder isn't available. What do you do? If your answer is "wait until someone tells me," this role isn't the right fit. If your answer is "find out which of sales reps is working on it and action the pause myself," you're exactly who we're looking for.



We also want someone who can follow process and direction well - this isn't about going rogue, it's about knowing when to act and when to check first.



WHAT WOULD HELP



-Experience with CRM systems and/or outbound sales/call-centre support (any platform - we'll train you on ours)

-Comfortable using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to help solve unfamiliar problems (not required, but a strong plus)

-Strong written English

-Prior experience in an agency or fast-moving small-business environment



**** HOW TO APPLY - READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY ****



Please include your CV/Resume, and answer the following as part of your application:



Some context: each morning, our sales reps start their calling campaigns for the day. Sometimes a sales rep can't see the campaign they're supposed to be working on in the sales dialer (which is where they call people from for allocated campaigns for the day). As the person in ops/sales support role, you'll have visibility and access across all campaigns and reps.



Scenario: It's 9:05am. The founder isn't available. A sales rep messages you saying he can't find the campaign he's supposed to work on today. What do you do?



*****Applications that don't answer this won't be considered - we read every one properly, so take your time.

FULL-TIME | LONG-TERM | WORK FROM HOME | $600-$900/month



We run an online fitness coaching business with around 140 active clients. Our head coach is at capacity. Clients are waiting too long for replies, check-ins are slipping, and some people who paid for a year have barely heard from us. That is the problem you are being hired to fix.



This is a real coaching seat, not a data-entry VA role. You will own a book of clients and be the person they hear from every week.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run weekly check-ins for your assigned clients: review their numbers, photos and training logs, then write a specific reply that tells them what to change

- Answer client messages inside the coaching app (TrainHeroic) and keep response time under 12 hours

- Adjust training programs and nutrition targets based on what the check-in data actually shows

- Get on short video calls with clients when a message will not cut it

- Spot the clients going quiet before they go quiet, and pull them back in

- Keep clean notes on every client so nothing gets lost



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Real coaching experience. You have personally taken clients through fat loss or muscle gain and can talk about what you changed and why

- Solid grasp of programming and nutrition: progressive overload, deficits and surpluses, macros, how to adjust when someone stalls

- Excellent written English. You are the voice of the brand every single week

- Comfortable on camera and on calls with US-based clients

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to take calls, and hours that overlap the US

- Organised. Managing 40+ clients at once without dropping anyone is the actual skill here



NICE TO HAVE

- A certification (NASM, ISSA, ACE, or similar)

- Experience inside TrainHeroic, Trainerize, or a similar coaching app

- Your own training background



THE DETAILS

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- $600-$900 per month depending on experience, paid monthly

- Long-term. We want someone who grows into a lead coach role, not a three-month stopgap

- Fully remote



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include all of the following in your application. Applications that skip these get deleted:



1. How many clients have you coached at once, and in which app?

2. Describe one client you coached from start to finish. What was their starting point, what did you change along the way, and where did they end up?

3. A client has not logged a workout in 10 days and is not answering messages. Write out exactly what you would send them.

4. What are your working hours in US Eastern Time?



Start your application with the word COACH so we know you read this to the end. Shortlisted applicants will be asked for a short video introduction.

title: Senior Brand & Web Designer
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Brand & Web Designer to help us refresh the branding and redesign the websites for two established Australian FMCG company brands.



This is a project-based role for someone with strong brand identity, art direction and website/UI design experience. Experience in FMCG, food, retail or consumer brands is highly preferred.



We’re looking for someone with a modern, distinctive design style who can bring their own creative thinking to the project — not simply execute a supplied brief.



About the Project:

The project involves developing a Brand Guidelines Book and website redesign for each of our two company brands.



Brand Guidelines

The existing logos are already established, so this is not a complete rebrand or new logo design project.



The existing brand foundations will be retained and evolved.



The work will focus on developing and refining areas such as:

Colour palette

Typography

Graphic elements and motifs

Visual language

Photography/imagery direction

Iconography

Digital applications

Website visual direction

Brand usage guidelines



We will provide an existing brand/creative brief and relevant assets as a starting point.



We’re looking for a designer who can interpret the brief and use their own design expertise to develop a cohesive, contemporary visual system.



Website Redesign

The existing websites contain much of the required content, so the focus is largely on restructuring and redesigning the existing pages to make them more modern, engaging and visually distinctive.



The website work will include:

Redesigning existing webpages

Improving content hierarchy and layouts

Developing concepts for some new pages

Improving product and brand presentation

Applying the new Brand Guidelines consistently

Improving the overall UX

Developing a cohesive visual language across the website



We already have content direction, wireframes and initial concepts prepared.



These are intended to communicate the structure and objectives of the website, not to dictate the final design.



We want to work collaboratively with the designer and welcome recommendations around UX, layout, visual hierarchy, page concepts and creative direction.



If you see a better way of approaching something, we want you to tell us.



Visual Direction:

We’re looking for a modern, premium, fresh and visually-led website with strong typography, distinctive layouts, art-directed imagery, product storytelling and engaging visual hierarchy.



Visual references:

Acho Que Bueno: 

OLIPOP: 





These are visual references, not templates to copy. We’re interested in their level of art direction, composition, typography and brand expression.



Our websites are corporate FMCG websites rather than e-commerce, so the design should feel engaging and contemporary while working effectively for both B2B and consumer audiences.



What We’re Looking For -

Must have:

Senior-level branding/graphic design experience

Strong portfolio demonstrating brand identity and visual systems

Strong website design experience

Excellent typography and layout skills

Experience creating Brand Guidelines

Strong visual/art direction skills

Good understanding of UI/UX

Ability to develop concepts rather than simply execute instructions

Strong attention to detail

Good communication and collaborative working style

Available to start immediately



Highly preferred:

FMCG / food / retail / consumer brand experience

UI/UX experience

Corporate/B2B website experience

WordPress experience

Ability to design and build websites in WordPress

Experience working with international/multi-market brands

WordPress is a bonus



It would be ideal if you can take the project from:

Brand → Website Design → UI/UX → WordPress Development



If you are a strong senior brand/web designer who can work alongside a separate WordPress developer, we would still love to see your portfolio.



------------------------------------

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief design exercise focused on a small website section. This will help us assess your creative thinking, art direction, typography, composition, brand interpretation, UI/UX, visual storytelling and overall design judgement.



The test will be limited in scope and will not require a full website or brand identity.



To Apply

Please provide:

Portfolio link

2–3 relevant branding/Brand Guidelines projects

2–3 relevant website/UI projects

FMCG/food/retail examples, if available

WordPress projects you personally designed/developed (if applicable)

Availability / earliest start date

Estimated project fee and timeline

Availability during Australian business hours



Briefly tell us: What makes a modern FMCG website feel distinctive and engaging rather than like a conventional corporate website?

title: Civil/Structural Engineer - Report Production Team for US Engineering Firm (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Civil/Structural Engineer – Engineering Report Production



Full-Time Remote Contractor | Long-Term Position | $1,500-$1,800 USD/month



Thomas Engineering Consultants (TEC) is a U.S.-based structural engineering firm seeking a Civil or Structural Engineer located in the Philippines to join our Engineering Report Production Team.



This is a full-time, long-term position working directly with an established U.S. engineering company. You will work alongside other report-production team members and help convert field data collected by our engineers into complete professional engineering reports.



This is not simply an AutoCAD drafting position. We are looking for an engineer who can understand the data, prepare drawings and calculations accurately, assemble technical reports, and recognize when something does not look correct.



What You Will Do



TEC performs residential foundation evaluations. Our field engineers collect measurements, foundation elevations, photographs, sketches, and observations at each property.



Your job will be to take that information and help turn it into a finished engineering report.



Typical responsibilities include:



Convert field sketches and measurements into accurate scaled residential floor plans using AutoCAD.

Plot foundation elevation measurements on floor plans.

Prepare foundation elevation survey drawings and topographic-style engineering exhibits.

Enter and process field data using Microsoft Excel.

Assist with foundation deflection, tilt, differential elevation, slope, and related engineering calculations using TEC templates.

Compare current elevation data with previous surveys when available.

Prepare foundation repair plans and other engineering drawings based on instructions from the licensed professional engineer.

Organize inspection photographs and field observations.

Prepare and assemble engineering reports using Microsoft Word and TEC templates.

Review previous engineering reports, foundation repair documents, plumbing information, geotechnical information, and other project records when necessary.

Perform quality-control checks of drawings, calculations, photographs, and reports.

Identify missing or inconsistent information and communicate questions to the engineering team.

Track multiple reports and meet daily production deadlines.

Maintain organized project files using Dropbox.



TEC completes multiple engineering evaluations every business day, so this position requires someone who is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a production environment.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.

Minimum 1 year of professional civil/structural engineering experience.

Strong AutoCAD skills.

Ability to convert hand sketches and measurements into accurate scaled CAD floor plans.

Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

Strong Microsoft Word skills.

Strong mathematical and analytical ability.

Excellent written English.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to follow established engineering procedures and templates.

Ability to manage several projects simultaneously.

Ability to work independently while remaining accountable to a team.

Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.



A Philippine PRC Registered Civil Engineer (RCE) credential is preferred but is not required.



Experience That Would Make You an Excellent Candidate



Experience in any of the following is especially valuable:



Structural engineering

Residential engineering

Foundation engineering

Concrete slab-on-ground foundations

Post-tensioned foundations

Geotechnical engineering

Foundation movement or settlement analysis

Residential construction

Topographic or elevation surveys

Engineering report preparation

Structural repair drawings

Quality-control review of engineering documents



Experience with Texas residential foundations is not required. TEC will provide training regarding our procedures, calculations, report formats, and engineering standards.



AutoCAD and Advanced Surface Modeling



TEC currently uses AutoCAD LT for standard report-production drawings, so strong 2D AutoCAD skills are required.



Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D, Revit, or comparable surface-modeling software is NOT required, but it would be a significant advantage.



TEC collects numerous elevation measurements across residential foundations. A candidate who can convert these points into a TIN surface, contour plan, 3D surface model, elevation profile, or cross section would bring an additional capability to our team.



If you have this experience, please tell us what software you use and provide examples if available.



Because TEC currently uses AutoCAD LT, candidates offering this advanced capability should already have appropriate access to the required software.



Work Schedule



This position must work the same schedule as the rest of our Engineering Report Production Team:



Monday through Friday

8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time



For candidates in the Philippines, this is an overnight work schedule.



Please apply only if you are comfortable maintaining these hours consistently on a long-term basis.



This is not an asynchronous freelance position. Team members work together throughout the day on the same projects, so availability during these hours is required.



Compensation



$1,500-$1,800 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.



We are intentionally offering compensation significantly above typical local engineering salaries because we are looking for an outstanding person who wants a stable, long-term position with our company.



Exceptional candidates with advanced technical capabilities such as Civil 3D/TIN surface modeling may be considered at a higher rate.



13th-month pay is provided.



Long-Term Opportunity

title: ACQUISITION RESEARCH & ORIGINATION ASSISTANT
description:
Entertainment, Events & Experiential Businesses



Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Position



About the Role



We are seeking an exceptional remote Research & Origination Assistant to support an international private investment operation.



This is not a conventional Virtual Assistant position.



Your primary responsibility will be identifying, researching and helping originate potential business acquisitions and commercial opportunities across sectors including:



Audio visual (AV) companies

Event production companies

Technical production businesses

Entertainment businesses

Venues and attractions

Experiential businesses

Festivals and live events

Hospitality-related entertainment businesses

Other businesses connected to the international events ecosystem



You will receive clearly defined acquisition criteria and research instructions.



Your job will be to turn those instructions into high-quality, actionable intelligence.



For example, you may be asked to identify privately owned AV companies within a particular US state that meet specified revenue, ownership and operational criteria.



You would then research the businesses, identify owners and decision-makers, gather relevant commercial information, locate appropriate contact details, record your findings accurately and, when instructed, make professional initial enquiries.



Core Responsibilities



You will:



Research companies matching specific acquisition criteria.

Identify founders, owners, shareholders and key decision-makers.

Research company size, locations, services, customers and market positioning.

Investigate ownership structures and corporate entities.

Find reliable contact information for decision-makers.

Research potential indicators of owner succession or willingness to sell.

Identify businesses that may not currently be publicly advertised for sale.

Search business-for-sale and M&A marketplaces.

Research industry databases, trade associations and company registries.

Review websites, LinkedIn, news articles, PDFs, financial information and other sources.

Conduct targeted online research using advanced search techniques.

Use AI tools intelligently to accelerate research while independently verifying important information.

Prepare concise company profiles and acquisition summaries.

Maintain accurate acquisition pipelines in spreadsheets and CRM systems.

Make professional
 enquiries using approved processes and templates.

Follow up with potential sellers and intermediaries when instructed.

Maintain comprehensive records of communications.

Identify inconsistencies or missing information rather than simply copying data.

Escalate particularly interesting opportunities.

The Person We Want



We are particularly interested in candidates who are naturally investigative.



If you cannot find information immediately, your instinct should be to find another route.



For example, if the owner's
 address is unavailable, you might investigate:



LinkedIn

Corporate registrations

Trade associations

Conference programmes

Press releases

Company documents

Alternative company websites

Related businesses


 structures

Industry directories



We value resourcefulness significantly more than simply completing tasks quickly.



Essential Skills



You must have:



Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong internet research ability.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel capability.

Professional
-writing ability.

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT.

Ability to work independently from written instructions.

Ability to organise large amounts of information.

Strong judgement regarding source reliability.

Ability to distinguish verified facts from estimates or assumptions.

Confidence learning unfamiliar industries.

Reliable computer and internet access.



Experience with any of the following is advantageous:



M&A

Private equity

Investment research

Lead generation

Business development

Commercial research

CRM systems

LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Apollo

PitchBook

Crunchbase

Companies House

US state corporate databases

Business-for-sale marketplaces

Event production / AV industries



You do NOT need previous family-office experience.



Exceptional researchers from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply.



Working Style



You should be comfortable receiving an instruction such as:



“Identify privately owned event-production companies in Florida meeting the attached acquisition criteria. Determine ownership, approximate scale, services, locations, key decision-makers and contact routes. Rank the strongest opportunities and explain your reasoning.”



We expect you to determine how to conduct the research rather than requiring instructions for every individual search.



Compensation



Target base compensation: $1,200–£1,500 per month, depending on experience and capability.



Performance-related compensation may be available for exceptional performance.



This is intended to become a long-term position for the right person.



Career Opportunity



A successful candidate will gain exposure to international acquisitions, investment research, commercial negotiations and business development.



The role can grow considerably as the investment portfolio expands.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send only a CV.



Please answer every application question below.



1. Where are you based?



2. What hours and time zone do you normally work?



3. What monthly salary are you seeking in GBP?



4. Describe your previous research experience.



5. Describe any experience you have researching companies, founders, directors or business owners.



6. Which research tools, databases and software platforms can you use confidently?



7. Rate your Excel/Google Sheets ability from 1–10 and explain what you can actually do.



8. Which AI tools do you use professionally and how do you verify information they provide?



9. You find an excellent acquisition target but cannot find the owner's
 address. Explain, step-by-step, what you would do next.



10. You find three different websites reporting different revenue figures for the same private company. What would you do?



11. What information would you want to know before deciding whether a privately owned AV company might make an attractive acquisition?



12. Imagine you have been asked to find 30 companies meeting specific criteria. After four hours you have found only six. What do you do?



13. Give an example of a situation where you solved a problem without being told exactly how to solve it.



14. Are you comfortable making professional enquiries to company owners and senior executives?



15. How would you ensure that 100+ potential acquisition targets and their communications remained organised?



16. What is the difference between a fact, an estimate and an assumption in commercial research?



17. Are you currently working for other clients or employers? If yes, explain your commitments.



18. What computer, internet connection and backup arrangements do you have?



19. Why does this particular role interest you?



20. Attention-to-detail instruction: At the very end of your application, after answering every question, write the words:



BLUE ELEPHANT 27



Applications missing this instruction may not be considered.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Jonathan Wang Design (JWD) is looking for a reliable and organized Finance Head / Finance Manager to oversee the company's day-to-day financial operations. 

This person will be responsible for keeping JWD's finances accurate, organized, and up to date. The role will work closely with company leadership, the Admin team, Project Managers, employees, vendors, suppliers, clients, and our external accountant/CPA.

 We are looking for someone who is trustworthy, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable taking full ownership of the finance function.



Responsibilities:

The Finance Head will manage JWD's bookkeeping and accounting records, primarily through QuickBooks. This includes recording income and expenses, reconciling bank accounts, maintaining financial records, preparing invoices, tracking payments, and making sure transactions are properly documented.

The role will manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. This includes reviewing and processing vendor and supplier invoices, coordinating approved payments, tracking outstanding client payments, following up on overdue invoices, and keeping management informed of upcoming and outstanding payments.

The Finance Head will also handle employee expenses and reimbursements, coordinate payroll with the appropriate provider or accountant, and make sure all related records are accurate and properly maintained.

Because JWD is a project-based design and construction-related business, the Finance Head will work with the project and admin teams to track project expenses, vendor costs, client payments, and other project-related financial information.

The Finance Head will prepare regular financial reports for management, including basic income and expense reports, accounts payable and receivable, cash flow, and other financial information needed by Jonathan and the leadership team to understand the company's financial position.

The role will also coordinate with JWD's external CPA, accountant, tax professionals, banks, and other financial service providers to make sure financial requirements and deadlines are handled properly.

An important part of the position is keeping JWD's financial information organized and accessible. Financial records, documentation, processes, and knowledge should be maintained as company assets and should not depend on one individual. The Finance Head will also help improve and maintain simple finance procedures and SOPs so that the company's financial processes are clear, consistent, and easy for the team to follow.



Tools & Systems:

The Finance Head will primarily use QuickBooks for bookkeeping, invoicing, financial records, reconciliations, and reporting.



JWD also uses Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, Google Docs, and Google Calendar for financial tracking, documentation, communication, and scheduling.



Slack is used for internal communication and coordination, while WhatsApp is used when communicating with vendors, suppliers, management, and other external contacts when necessary.



The Finance Head may also work with online banking platforms, payroll systems, payment platforms, Microsoft Teams, and other tools used by JWD.



What We Are Looking For:

We are looking for someone with experience in finance, accounting, bookkeeping, or financial administration who can independently manage day-to-day financial responsibilities. The ideal person is highly organized, detail-oriented, trustworthy, proactive, and comfortable working with numbers. They should be able to identify problems, communicate them clearly, and follow through until they are resolved. Experience with QuickBooks, Google Sheets, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, invoicing, and financial reporting is important. Experience working with a design, construction, architecture, real estate, or other project-based company is a plus.



The Goal of the Role:

Keep JWD's finances accurate, organized, timely, and visible so that leadership can confidently understand the company's financial position and make informed business decisions.

description:

This isn’t a “run meetings and update trackers” role. You’ll work directly with founders to take ownership of the business workflows, bring order to chaos, and use tech/AI to create leverage wherever possible. Every team, every project, every cross-functional handoff — you’re the one making sure it all moves.



The Role

Reporting: Directly to Founders

Type: Leadership role with full operational ownership



What You’ll Actually Do

- Own End-to-End Execution

- Lead cross-functional projects from idea to launch across ecommerce channels, marketing campaigns, product launches, and catalogue management

- Define what needs to happen, by when, and by whom — then make sure it actually happens

- Break down founder vision into executable roadmaps with clear milestones and accountability

- Understand marketing fundamentals (CAC, ROAS, funnel optimization) enough to have intelligent conversations and catch issues early

- Coordinate between creative, copywriting, paid ads, email, and content teams

- Bridge the gap between marketing goals and operational reality



Build Structure (Without Bureaucracy)

- Establish rituals (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews) that drive results, not just meetings

Leverage Technology & Automation

- Stay current on AI and automation trends; test what gives us an edge

- Push the team toward tech-enabled efficiency



Cross-Functional Leadership

- Coordinate across ecommerce, marketing, catalogue, creative, and support teams

- Translate business priorities into clear action plans with owners

- Run productive meetings that end with decisions and next steps

- Manage internal tea
mbers, contractors, and agency partners



Drive Results & Accountability

- Anticipate risks before they become problems

- Ensure projects ship on time, within scope, and actually move the business forward

- Provide weekly updates to founders with real insight, not just status reports

- Own outcomes, not just outputs



What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

- You’ve taken ownership of 3–5 active initiatives and brought clarity to what was chaos

- Marketing team projects are running smoother with clear workflows and timelines

- Founders have visibility into what’s happening without having to ask

- You’ve implemented 2–3 automations that save the team hours every week

- The team actually uses the systems you’ve built



You’re a Great Fit If You Have

Must-Haves

- 8–12 years working in ecommerce or digital businesses (agency, brand, or marketplace side)

- Direct experience managing ecommerce operations on platforms like Shopify, Amazon, Wayfair, or Walmart

- Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals and campaign execution — you’ve coordinated marketing teams or projects before

- Startup or high-growth company experience where you wore multiple hats and figured things out

- Hands-on experience with project management tools (Asana strongly preferred)

- Track record of building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — not just operating within existing ones

- Proven ability to lead and manage people with real authority — not just coordinate

- Track record of getting things done in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

- Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)

- Experience managing remote teams across time zones

- Tech-savvy mindset — comfortable with new tools and AI/automation



Bonus Points

- Experience working directly with founders or C-suite as their operational right hand

- Background in catalogue management, product launches, or creative operations

- Hands-on experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, ChatGPT, n8n)

- Knowledge of SEO, marketplaces, or ecommerce analytics

- Experience scaling a business from early stage — you’ve seen what breaks at $1M, $5M, $10M



Tools You’ll Work With

- Project & Collaboration: Asana, Notion, Slack, Loom, Google Workspace

- Ecommerce Platforms: Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, marketplace dashboards, ERP/OMS tools

- Automation & AI: Zapier, Make, n8n, ChatGPT, various AI tools



Work Setup

This is a fully remote role. You must have:

- Your own reliable laptop/desktop system

- Stable internet connection

- Professional home office setup

- Company-issued hardware is not provided.



Why Join our Company?

- Direct Founder Access — You’ll work directly with founders who value execution over bureaucracy. Your voice matters.

- High Ownership — This isn’t a “wait for instructions” role. You’ll own real business outcomes and shape how we operate.

- Remote Flexibility — Work from anywhere with flexible hours, as long as you have EST overlap for key collaborations.

- Fast-Paced Growth — We’re scaling quickly across channels. You’ll see the direct impact of your work on revenue and growth.

- Tech-Forward Culture — We embrace automation, AI, and smart systems. If you love finding better ways to work, you’ll thrive here.

You'll receive clear written specs for new builds. What we need from you is ownership: you notice what's broken before anyone asks, and you tell us plainly what's done and what isn't.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

- 2+ years building and maintaining funnels and
 automation for coaches, course creators or info-product businesses

BONUS

- Stripe, Cloudflare, Airtable/Notion
