title: Event Operations & Logistics Coordinator
description:
Pay: $5–$7 USD/hour

Hours: 10–20 hours per week

Schedule: Part-time, ongoing through January 2027, with potential to continue

Location: Remote

Time zone: Some overlap with U.S. Mountain Time required



About the Role



We are producing a multi-night immersive masquerade event series in Colorado, USA in January 2027.



The events will include live music, DJs, dance, food and beverage, performers, artists, interactive experiences, VIP hospitality, community partners, sponsors, and multiple event spaces.



We already have venues, vendors, performers, committee members, and other team members involved.



We are looking for a highly organized Event Operations & Logistics Coordinator who can help bring all of the moving pieces together and make sure important details do not fall through the cracks.



This is primarily a remote coordination and project-management role.



You will work closely with the Founder / Executive Producer and help turn meetings, ideas, vendor conversations, and creative plans into organized timelines, checklists, assignments, and operational plans.



Your Main Responsibilities



You will help manage and coordinate areas such as:



Master event timeline and planning calendar

Project task tracking

Vendor coordination and follow-up

Venue requirements

Catering and bar logistics

Performer and entertainment logistics

Arrival times and schedules

Load-in and load-out planning

Event setup and breakdown planning

Run-of-show development

Event-day staffing plans

Captain and team assignments

Guest-flow planning

VIP and general admission operations

Green rooms and performer areas

Equipment and rental tracking

Insurance / COI tracking

Vendor contact sheets

Event checklists

Meeting notes and action items

Following up on missing information

Identifying potential operational problems before they become urgent

A Very Important Part of the Role



You will act as the bridge between our remote planning team and the people physically running the events in Colorado.



Our on-site lead, Olimpia, will act as the general/executor during setup and event days.



Your job will be to help make sure she and the rest of the event team have a clear operational plan before the event begins.



For example:



Who arrives when?

Who is responsible for each area?

Where does each vendor go?

When do performers arrive?

Who handles check-in?

Who handles VIP?

Who is responsible for each activation?

What needs to happen during setup?

What happens if something changes?

Who does each person report to?



The goal is for the event team to have clear instructions and systems so the Founder does not have to personally coordinate every detail.



Who We Are Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized

Reliable

Proactive

Detail-oriented

Comfortable managing many moving pieces

Strong with follow-up

Comfortable communicating with vendors

Able to create clear systems and checklists

Good at turning conversations into tasks

Comfortable working independently

Able to notice missing information

Calm when plans change

Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

Able to prioritize urgent vs. non-urgent work



We are especially interested in people who do not simply wait for instructions.



If you notice:



“We are missing the caterer arrival time”



or



“This performer has not provided technical requirements yet,”



we want you to identify that and follow up.



Experience We Would Love



Experience in any of the following is helpful:



Event coordination

Event planning

Weddings

Conferences

Festivals

Hospitality

Production coordination

Project management

Vendor management

Executive or project-based virtual assistance

Operations coordination



You do not need to be a senior event producer.



Someone with excellent organizational and project-management skills who is eager to learn event operations could also be a strong fit.



Tools



You should be comfortable with:



Google Sheets

Google Docs

Google Drive

Gmail

Zoom / Google Meet

WhatsApp

Project-management tools



Experience with Canva is helpful but not required.



If you already have project-management systems that you like, we are open to your recommendations.



Hours & Availability



We expect approximately 10 hours per week initially.



This may increase to 15–20 hours per week as the January events approach.



Some weekday availability during U.S. Mountain Time is important for meetings and vendor coordination.



You do not need to work U.S. hours all day.



We mainly need a reasonable amount of overlap.



Event Dates



The current primary event dates are in January 2027 in Colorado, USA.



The busiest planning period will likely be:



October 2026 through January 2027



You will work remotely with the team executing the events locally.



Compensation



$5–$7 USD per hour, depending on experience.



There may be an opportunity for increased responsibility and continued work after the January events if the relationship is a strong fit.



To Apply



Please answer all of the following:



Tell me briefly about yourself.

What experience do you have with event coordination, operations, project management, or complex VA work?

Tell me about one event or project that had many moving pieces. What were you responsible for?

What tools do you normally use to organize projects?

How do you make sure deadlines and follow-ups do not get forgotten?

How would you handle a vendor who has not responded and an important deadline is approaching?

How many hours per week are you currently available?

What hours are you normally available in Philippine Time?

Are you comfortable attending occasional meetings during U.S. Mountain Time?

What hourly rate are you requesting?



Please begin your application with:



LUMINARY OPERATIONS



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



About Us



The Luminary Masquerade is being developed as an elevated, immersive event experience combining music, movement, art, hospitality, mystery, masks, light and shadow.



We are building a collaborative team where artists and performers are encouraged to bring their own creativity into the larger story.



We are looking for someone who enjoys creating order behind ambitious creative projects and who takes pride in helping a team execute something memorable.

description:
We're a Dutch-owned e-commerce company running our own DTC brands. We advertise on Meta every single day and produce a lot of video creative. We're hiring one person to own a specific, high-impact piece of that: keeping our best-performing ads alive longer.



You do NOT need to speak Spanish. Our markets are Spanish-speaking, but all briefs, tools and internal communication are in English.



What you'll actually do

Our senior strategist owns new concepts and angles. You own everything after a creative starts winning:



Check active winners weekly for fatigue (frequency climbing, CPM rising, ROAS sliding) and flag them before they crash

Write hook variations — genuinely different first 3 seconds: visual, voiceover, or structural, not just a new opening line

Repurpose proven creatives across our other products where the angle transfers

Log every iteration and its result, so we know which types actually extend a winner's life

Brief our video editors clearly (we have a full editing team — you don't edit)



Who we're looking for



1+ year with direct-response video ads on Meta

You can read Ads Manager yourself (frequency, CPM, ROAS, CPA) and draw a conclusion from it

Strong written English, organized, responsive on Slack

You know the difference between a real hook variation and a cosmetic edit



Nice to have, not required: Shopify or COD offer experience.



What you get



Full-time, 40 hrs/week, long-term role — we're hiring someone to stay, not for a project

One clear area of ownership, direct contact with the founders, real ad budget behind your ideas

Room to grow into broader creative strategy as we scale



How to apply (please read)



Start your subject line with PURPLE-TOE — we filter for it, applications without it aren't seen

Record a short Loom or voice note (60–90 sec, phone audio is fine) answering: "An ad has run 3 weeks, frequency is 1.8, ROAS is dropping. Give me 3 hook variations you'd make — and why each is genuinely different, not cosmetic."

In writing: one ad you personally iterated that failed and what you think went wrong, plus your expected monthly rate

title: Google Ads Support Specialist
description:
# Google Ads Support Specialist



**Remote | Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising**



## About Slaymaker Marketing



Slaymaker Marketing is a growing digital advertising agency managing paid-media campaigns for e-commerce and B2B clients. We combine senior-level strategy with hands-on execution across Google, Microsoft, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other advertising platforms.



We value honesty, improvement, respect, ownership, selflessness, and results. We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, pays close attention to detail, and takes responsibility for producing accurate work.



## About the Role



We are hiring a Google Ads Support Specialist to support campaign implementation, optimization, QA, analysis, and reporting across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.



You will work alongside experienced account leads who own client strategy and communication. Your role will be to translate that strategy into accurate campaign execution, monitor account performance, maintain organized documentation, and proactively surface opportunities and concerns.



This role is ideal for someone with strong Google Ads fundamentals who wants to develop into an independent account manager and strategist.



## What You’ll Own Day to Day



* Build and update Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Display, and YouTube campaigns

* Conduct keyword, search-term, competitor, audience, and placement research

* Develop and implement keyword lists, match types, negatives, audiences, and targeting

* Draft and upload responsive search ads, extensions, assets, and other ad variations

* Make approved changes to bids, budgets, targeting, exclusions, and campaign settings

* Monitor spend pacing, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, impression share, and other relevant metrics

* Review search terms and identify negative keywords or expansion opportunities

* Conduct routine account checks and flag unusual performance or delivery changes

* Pull and organize data for client reporting and internal analysis

* Prepare performance notes, insights, and recommended actions before client calls

* Support Google Merchant Center and product-feed troubleshooting

* Maintain campaign naming conventions, labels, tracking templates, and UTMs

* Review conversion actions, attribution settings, URLs, and campaign goals

* Document completed changes, test results, open questions, and next steps

* Implement campaigns and changes in Microsoft Advertising when needed

* Proactively identify opportunities instead of waiting exclusively for assigned tasks



## QA Expectations



Every campaign build or major change must receive complete QA. You will be expected to verify:



* Campaign type, objective, bidding strategy, budget, and schedule

* Keywords, match types, negatives, audiences, and exclusions

* Geographic, demographic, device, network, and language settings

* Ad copy, assets, final URLs, tracking templates, and UTMs

* Conversion actions and campaign-level conversion goals

* Merchant Center products, feed settings, and product-group structures

* Brand exclusions, account-level negatives, and suitability settings

* Naming conventions and reporting consistency

* Alignment with the approved strategy and client instructions



## Required Qualifications



* Hands-on experience building and optimizing Google Ads campaigns

* Strong understanding of Search campaign structures and keyword strategy

* Familiarity with Shopping and Performance Max campaigns

* Ability to interpret performance data and identify meaningful trends

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to pre-launch QA

* Clear written English and dependable internal communication

* Strong organization and time-management skills

* Ability to manage work across multiple accounts and deadlines

* Willingness to document work and communicate progress proactively

* Ability to identify concerns and suggest solutions before escalating them



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience supporting both e-commerce and B2B lead-generation accounts

* Familiarity with Microsoft Advertising and Google Merchant Center

* Experience with GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, Shopify, and HubSpot

* Understanding of conversion tracking and offline conversion imports

* Experience with product feeds and feed-optimization tools

* Familiarity with value-based bidding, attribution, and lifecycle-stage reporting

* Experience working with monthly advertising budgets of $50,000 or more

* Familiarity with project-management and team-communication platforms



## What Success Looks Like



* Campaigns and optimizations are completed accurately and on schedule

* Every launch receives thorough QA

* Search-term reviews and account checks are completed consistently

* Reporting data and call-preparation notes are accurate and useful

* Performance issues are identified and escalated early

* Account leads have clear visibility into completed work and blockers

* Recommendations are supported by data and aligned with client goals

* You gradually progress from execution support toward independent ownership of smaller accounts



## What We’re Looking For



The right person is analytical, dependable, organized, and proactive. You should be comfortable following a defined strategy while also thinking critically about whether the requested implementation makes sense.



We do not want someone who blindly completes tasks. We want someone who checks their work, raises concerns, investigates performance changes, and contributes ideas for improvement.



To apply, please provide:



* A brief overview of your Google Ads experience

* The campaign types and monthly budgets you have managed or supported

* Examples of e-commerce or lead-generation accounts you have worked on

* An example of an optimization or QA issue you identified

* Your experience with GA4, GTM, Merchant Center, and Microsoft Advertising

* Your availability and preferred working hours

* Upload ad creative and copy while ensuring correct formatting across placements

* Implement campaign changes and optimizations assigned by account leads

* Conduct routine account checks and flag performance or delivery issues

* Monitor pacing, spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, frequency, and other relevant metrics

* Pull, organize, and summarize campaign data for reporting

* Support the development of testing plans for creative, audiences, offers, and landing pages

* Maintain campaign naming conventions and accurate UTM parameters

* Verify pixels, events, conversion settings, URLs, and tracking before launch

* Document completed work, campaign changes, test results, and next steps

* Coordinate with the creative team on asset requirements and performance feedback

* Proactively identify problems, opportunities, and recommended actions

* Escalate blockers or potential errors before they affect client performance



## QA Expectations



Quality assurance is a central part of this role. Before anything launches, you will be expected to verify:



* Campaign, ad set, and ad settings

* Budgets, schedules, audiences, exclusions, and placements

* Creative files, copy, links, and calls to action

* Destination URLs and UTM parameters

* Pixel and conversion-event selection

* Geographic, demographic, and device targeting

* Naming conventions and reporting consistency

* Alignment with the approved strategy and client instructions



## Required Qualifications



* Hands-on experience building and managing Meta Ads campaigns

* Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Events Manager, and Business Manager

* Understanding of paid-social campaign structures and optimization principles

* Ability to interpret advertising performance data

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to pre-launch QA

* Clear written English and reliable internal communication

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Ability to follow an approved strategy while identifying potential issues

* Comfortable managing multiple client accounts and deadlines

* Willingness to document work and communicate progress proactively



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience supporting e-commerce and B2B lead-generation accounts

* Familiarity with Shopify, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, and HubSpot

* Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, or Reddit advertising

* Understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, and UTM structures

* Experience analyzing creative performance and communicating findings

* Familiarity with project-management and team-communication platforms



## What Success Looks Like



* Campaigns are built accurately and launched on schedule

* Every launch receives complete QA before publication

* Account leads have clear visibility into completed work and blockers

* Performance issues are identified and escalated quickly

* Reporting data is accurate, organized, and delivered on time

* Campaign documentation remains current

* You increasingly contribute recommendations instead of waiting only for assigned tasks

* You grow toward greater strategic and account-level ownership



## What We’re Looking For



The right person is dependable, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership. You should be willing to ask questions when something is unclear, but you should also investigate problems and propose solutions before escalating them.



To apply, please provide:



* A brief overview of your Meta Ads experience

* Examples of the types of accounts and monthly budgets you have supported

* The industries or business models you have worked with

* An example of an issue you caught during campaign QA

* Your availability and preferred working hours

title: Expert Performance Video Editor
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–30 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.

This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.

We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.

You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.

It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.

Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.

What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.

Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.

Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

title: Healthcare Growth & Partnerships
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Business Hours



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month



ABOUT RAVORA HEALTH



Ravora Health is a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice providing psychiatric evaluation, medication management, ADHD treatment, and care for conditions such as anxiety and depression.



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Business Development & Marketing Specialist to help us grow our patient base, develop relationships with healthcare referral partners, and execute marketing and growth projects.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys research, outreach, relationship building, marketing, and solving problems.



You will work directly with Ravora Health leadership and will be given meaningful projects to own.



We are looking for someone who can take an objective, figure out what needs to be done, organize the project, execute it, follow up, and report the results.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



1. HEALTHCARE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



A major responsibility will be helping Ravora Health build relationships with healthcare organizations that may refer patients to us.



Potential referral partners include:



* Primary care offices

* Therapy and counseling practices

* Psychologists

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Colleges and universities

* Other healthcare professionals



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding the appropriate decision-makers and contacts

* Collecting accurate phone numbers and
 addresses

* Researching services and accepted insurance plans

* Calling and
ing healthcare offices

* Introducing Ravora Health and our services

* Explaining our accepted insurance plans and referral process

* Learning how potential partners currently handle psychiatry referrals

* Scheduling meetings when appropriate

* Following up with contacts

* Maintaining long-term relationships



This is relationship-focused business development, not high-volume call-center telemarketing.



2. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH



You will help identify new opportunities for Ravora Health.



This may include:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Researching healthcare organizations

* Identifying decision-makers

* Researching competitors

* Finding community organizations

* Researching local businesses and employers

* Finding potential referral sources

* Identifying marketing opportunities

* Researching new patient-acquisition channels



We want someone who is very comfortable researching online and turning information into an organized action plan.



3. REFERRAL & CONTACT DATABASE MANAGEMENT



You will help create and maintain an organized database or CRM containing information such as:



* Organization name

* Contact person

* Phone

*

* Location

* Providers

* Accepted insurance

* Services offered

* Previous communication

* Relationship status

* Last contact

* Follow-up date

* Referrals generated



You will help make sure opportunities do not get forgotten and relationships are followed up consistently.



4. DIGITAL MARKETING & PATIENT ACQUISITION



You will also assist with marketing projects designed to bring new patients to Ravora Health.



Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY



We strongly encourage the use of AI and modern technology.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Google Workspace

* Project-management tools

* Automation tools



We want someone who looks for ways to use technology to make research, outreach, organization, and marketing more efficient.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you have experience in areas such as:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Marketing

* Healthcare

* Client relations

* Account management

* Partnership development

* Outreach

* Digital marketing

* Google Ads

* CRM management

* Project coordination

* Sales development



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare company is a strong advantage but is not required.



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Confidence speaking professionally on the phone

* Strong research skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Good follow-up habits

* Professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Comfort with outbound outreach

* Ability to learn new tools quickly

* Ability to manage several projects

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S. healthcare offices during U.S. business hours.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are not searching for someone who already knows everything.



We are searching for someone who is:



* Resourceful

* Reliable

* Organized

* Curious

* Comfortable taking initiative

* Strong at communication

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to take ownership of assignments



If we give you a goal, we want you to be able to research it, create a plan, execute it, follow up, and show us what happened.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



Hours: 40 hours per week



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month depending on experience and skill level.



Because a significant part of this position involves communicating with U.S. healthcare offices, you must be available during a meaningful portion of U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term role.



Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance, reliability, project ownership, and overall contribution.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



RAVORA GROWTH



Then include the following:



1. INTRODUCTION



Tell us briefly about your background and why this position interests you.



2. RESUME



Please include your current resume or CV.



3. VOICE RECORDING



Please provide a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself.



A major part of this role involves professional communication with U.S. healthcare offices, so spoken English is important.



4. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us about any experience you have with:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Healthcare

* Marketing

* Client outreach

* Google Ads

* CRM systems

title: AI Performance Video Editor
description:
We are looking for an exceptional AI Video Editor to join our creative team and produce high-performing video advertisements for our e-commerce brands.



This is not a traditional video editing position.



We need someone who can take a detailed creative brief and turn it into a finished Meta ad from start to finish, including AI UGC, AI actors, B-roll, product scenes, voiceovers, visual effects, captions, sound design and final editing.



Our goal is simple:



Create AI advertisements that look real, feel native to the feed and sell products.



What you'll be creating



You will work across several different creative formats:



Realistic AI UGC advertisements

Direct-response Meta ads

Problem → solution ads

AI spokesperson / talking-head ads

Storytelling ads

Product demonstrations

VSL-style ads

Authority/expert-style creatives

Before/after storytelling concepts

Cinematic product scenes

AI-generated B-roll

Variations of winning ads

Different hooks, openings and CTAs for creative testing



We provide detailed briefs containing the concept, script, scenes, dialogue, visual direction, references, product information and marketing angle.



Your responsibility is to turn the brief into an excellent finished advertisement.



You need to be excellent with AI



We are looking for someone who actively works with modern AI creative tools.



Experience with tools such as:



Google Veo / Flow, Kling, Higgsfield, Runway, Seedance, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Nano Banana, ChatGPT, CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar.



You do not need to use every tool.



What matters is that you know how to choose the right tool to achieve the result.



You should be able to create:



Realistic people.

Natural AI UGC.

Consistent characters between scenes.

Accurate products.

Natural voices and lip sync.

Realistic environments.

High-quality B-roll.



We don't want AI content that immediately looks AI-generated.



You also need to understand advertising



Being technically good with AI isn't enough.



You should understand:



Hooks. Retention. Pacing. Pattern interrupts. Direct response. Storytelling. Visual hierarchy. Captions. Product demonstrations. Objection handling. CTAs.



The objective isn't to make the prettiest video.



The objective is to make people stop scrolling, keep watching and ultimately buy.



This distinction is also consistent with current performance-editor hiring: companies are explicitly screening for hook/retention judgment and ads that convert rather than editors who only make attractive videos.



What we're looking for



We're looking for someone who:



Has strong AI video-generation experience

Has created UGC/direct-response advertisements

Has experience with e-commerce / DTC brands

Can execute detailed briefs independently

Has excellent attention to detail

Can spot obvious AI mistakes immediately

Can maintain character and product consistency

Understands Meta advertising creative

Can create multiple variations efficiently

Can take feedback and improve quickly

Has strong English

Communicates reliably

Can deliver consistently and on time



You should care about details such as incorrect hands, strange movements, unnatural voices, bad lip sync, incorrect products, inconsistent characters, AI-looking skin, wrong text and continuity errors.



What we offer



We operate established e-commerce brands selling physical consumer products across multiple European markets.



You'll work directly with our creative team on advertisements that receive real advertising spend, meaning you'll get feedback from actual performance data rather than subjective opinions.



When an advertisement performs well, we'll create additional hooks, angles and iterations from it.



For the right person, this can become a long-term/full-time position with significant creative volume.



How to apply



Do NOT send us 30 random videos.



Send us:



Your 3 best AI advertisements/videos

Your 3 best AI UGC examples

Examples of ads you personally created that actually ran on Meta/TikTok

Any performance results or advertising spend you can legitimately share

Which AI tools you currently use

Which editing software you use

Your availability

Your expected monthly salary



At the beginning of your application, write:



“PERFORMANCE FIRST”



Applications without this will not be considered.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical test using one of our actual creative briefs.

title: EXPERIENCED Trucking Operations & Driver Compliance Coordinator
description:
# Trucking Operations & Driver Compliance Coordinator

**Location:** Remote 

**Schedule:** Full-time, with availability during [U.S. time zone and hours]  

**Compensation:** Based on experience



We are looking for an organized, dependable coordinator to support our trucking operations. You will help recruit drivers, maintain driver and truck paperwork, coordinate drug testing, and prepare drivers for training and road assignments.



This role requires strong follow-through, accurate recordkeeping, and clear communication with drivers, management, testing facilities, and other service providers.



## Responsibilities



**Driver recruitment and hiring**

- Post job openings, review applications, and communicate with candidates.

- Conduct initial screening and schedule interviews with management.

- Collect applications, employment history, licenses, and required hiring documents.

- Coordinate authorized background checks, driving-record reviews, and employment verification.

- Track each candidate from application through onboarding and keep management informed.



**Driver compliance and records**

- Maintain organized, up-to-date Driver Qualification Files (DQFs) and onboarding records.

- Track license, medical certificate, and other document expiration dates.

- Coordinate required record checks and follow-up reviews under company procedures.

- Identify missing, expired, or incomplete documents and follow up until resolved.

- Prepare files for management review and support audit preparation.

- Handle sensitive driver information confidentially.



**Drug and alcohol testing coordination**

- Schedule required pre-employment and other company-directed drug and alcohol tests.

- Send drivers testing locations, appointment details, and instructions.

- Follow up with drivers and authorized testing providers to confirm completion.

- Track testing status and route results or issues to authorized management.

- Assist with Clearinghouse-related administrative tasks where authorized.

- Escalate outstanding requirements before a driver is approved for duty.



**Driver onboarding, training, and road preparation**

- Coordinate orientation, required training, and road-test appointments with qualified personnel.

- Collect signed policies, acknowledgments, and training records.

- Help drivers set up required apps, ELD access, and communication tools.

- Review company procedures with drivers, including inspections, paperwork submission, and reporting breakdowns or incidents.

- Confirm that onboarding documents, training records, and truck assignment details are complete.

- Maintain a ready-for-road checklist and submit it to management for final approval.



**Truck and trailer paperwork**

- Maintain records for registrations, insurance, inspections, permits, and other applicable vehicle documents.

- Track renewal deadlines and coordinate updates with management and service providers.

- Confirm that drivers have current copies of required truck and trailer paperwork.

- Collect inspection reports and coordinate follow-up on missing records or reported issues.

- Keep vehicle files organized and accessible.



**Daily coordination and reporting**

- Communicate with drivers, dispatch, management, clinics, and training providers.

- Maintain trackers for recruiting, onboarding, testing, document renewals, and training.

- Provide daily updates on completed tasks, outstanding items, and urgent issues.

- Follow through on open tasks and escalate anything that could delay a driver’s start or truck availability.



## Qualifications



- Experience supporting a U.S. trucking company in recruiting, safety, compliance, or operations.

- Working familiarity with DOT/FMCSA terminology, driver qualification files, CDL documentation, and drug-testing coordination.

- Strong spoken and written English.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple drivers and deadlines.

- Comfortable using spreadsheets,
, shared document storage, and trucking software.

- Reliable internet, a computer, and a quiet workspace.

- Available during the agreed U.S. business hours.



**Preferred:** Experience with the FMCSA Clearinghouse, ELD platforms, applicant tracking systems, and compliance-management software.



## What Success Looks Like



- Driver and vehicle files are complete, organized, and current.

- Candidates receive timely communication throughout hiring.

- Testing, orientation, and training are coordinated without avoidable delays.

- Missing requirements are flagged before road assignments.

- Management has a clear view of who is ready, what is pending, and what needs attention.



This is an administrative and coordination role. Final hiring, safety, and driver-release decisions remain with authorized management.



## How to Apply



Please send your résumé and a brief response to the following:



1. What experience do you have supporting U.S. trucking operations?

2. Which driver hiring, compliance, and onboarding tasks have you personally handled?

3. Have you coordinated drug tests, maintained DQFs, or supported Clearinghouse processes?

4. Which trucking software and office tools have you used?

5. What U.S. hours can you work, and what is your expected monthly compensation?

You should be comfortable creating both short-form and longer educational videos using an existing HeyGen avatar, including editing the final video so it feels polished, interesting and appropriate for social media and YouTube.



## YOU SHOULD BE PROFICIENT IN:



• HeyGen

• CapCut

• Instagram Edits

• Short-form video editing

• Long-form YouTube editing

• Reels and TikTok formatting

• YouTube Shorts

• Hooks, pacing, captions and transitions

• Music/audio selection

• Creating videos that hold attention

• Canva when needed for video assets



Beauty, skincare, aesthetics, wellness or medical-spa experience is a BIG PLUS.



## WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



We are not looking for the fanciest résumé.



**We care about your actual work.**



We want someone who:



• Has a strong visual eye

• Understands current short-form content

• Knows how to grab attention in the first few seconds

• Can make educational content interesting

• Can follow an established luxury beauty aesthetic

• Takes direction well

• Communicates clearly

• Meets deadlines

• Can work independently

• Is open to feedback and revisions

• Wants a consistent, long-term position



You will work under our existing social media/brand manager. She will provide direction, review your videos and give feedback so you understand our brand.



Our goal is to build a small team of talented video creators so there is always fresh content being produced.



## PAID TRIAL



We will be selecting several strong applicants for a **small paid trial project**.



Everyone will receive similar source material so we can evaluate creativity, editing ability, speed and how well you understand our brand.



The strongest person/persons may be offered ongoing weekly work.



## TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your hourly rate.

3. How many hours per week you are available.

4. Links to **3–5 of your BEST videos** — please do not send us 50 examples.

5. Examples of beauty, skincare, wellness or aesthetic content if you have them.

6. Examples of Reels/TikToks/YouTube Shorts you have edited.

7. Examples of long-form YouTube videos you have edited.

8. **Examples of videos you personally created using HeyGen.**

9. Tell us which programs you use regularly: HeyGen, CapCut, Instagram Edits, Canva, Adobe Premiere, etc.

10. Tell us how long it typically takes you to edit one 30–60 second Reel from provided raw footage.



**IMPORTANT:** Please begin your application with the words **“GLOW VIDEO”** so we know you read the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone creative, reliable and excited to grow with us. If you have a great eye, understand video and can take raw content and turn it into something people actually want to watch, we would love to see your work.

title: Wordpress Technical Specialist
description:
ABOUT US

We are an Australian digital agency working with service-based businesses. Our services include WordPress websites, SEO, Google Business Profile management, Google Ads management, hosting, maintenance and technical support.

We are looking for an experienced WordPress Technical Specialist to join our team as a long-term Philippines-based contractor.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who is confident in their ability, works well independently and can take technical work off our CEO and wider team. Working hours must overlap with Australian business hours, with a start time no later than 10:00 am Sydney time.



HONESTY MATTERS TO US

You do not need to know everything, and we do not expect you to.

We would much rather you tell us accurately where you are strong, where you have less experience and when you need to investigate something.

There is no advantage in overstating your skills.

Every shortlisted applicant completes  practical technical tests based on the skills and experience you tell us you have.

Making a mistake is not a problem. Hiding one is.



THE ROLE

You will handle technical work across our WordPress client websites, including:

Troubleshooting WordPress issues, plugin and theme conflicts

HTML, CSS and JavaScript changes

Elementor troubleshooting and customisation

Responsive and cross-browser issues

Website speed and performance optimisation

Website migrations

Hosting, cPanel, DNS, Cloudflare and SSL

Backups and restores

Technical SEO fixes and Google Search Console issues

GA4, Google Tag Manager and Google Ads conversion tracking

Website security and general technical support

We have SOPs and processes, but we also expect you to use your own judgement.

You should be able to investigate a problem, identify the likely cause and work towards a proper fix without every step being explained to you.



WHAT WE NEED

You must have strong, hands-on experience with:

WordPress

Elementor

HTML, CSS and JavaScript

Troubleshooting and debugging

Hosting, cPanel, DNS and SSL

You should also be someone who:

Takes ownership of their work

Works independently and does not need constant follow-up

Tests their own work before calling it done

Thinks through problems before escalating them

Understands the difference between fixing a symptom and fixing the cause

Speaks up when they see a better way of doing something

Communicates early if something has gone wrong or is taking longer than expected



GOOD TO HAVE

Experience with any of these is valuable, but not required:

PHP / Laravel

WooCommerce

Cloudflare and WHM

Malware removal and website security

GA4, Google Tag Manager and Google Ads conversion tracking

Google Search Console and schema

APIs, Zapier or n8n

Git

Website performance optimisation



ROOM TO GROW

Once you have proven yourself in the hands-on role, there is real opportunity to grow into a senior technical position working closely with our CTO.

That could include:

Guiding technical decisions

Improving our SOPs and technical processes

Helping prioritise technical work

Identifying risks before they become larger problems

Acting as the technical point of contact when the CTO is unavailable

You do not need management experience today.

Good judgement, maturity, leadership potential and the ability to take responsibility matter more. If you have read this far, start your application with the words "Blue Kangaroo".



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Technical issues are handled without constant supervision

Problems are investigated properly and fixed at the root cause

You tell us early when something goes wrong

The team trusts your technical judgement

Tasks do not need repeated follow-up

Our CEO and CTO spend less time dealing with day-to-day technical problems



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

A short introduction about your technical experience.

Links to WordPress websites you have worked on, and exactly what you did on each one.

Rate yourself from 1 to 5 on each item in "What We Need" and "Good to Have". For anything you rate 4 or 5, give one real example of work you have done with it.

Applications that skip any of these steps will not be considered.

title: Appointment Setter / Sales Follow-Up Specialist
description:
Appointment Setter / Sales Follow-Up Specialist

The Root Cause Doc™ | Remote | Part-Time





The Root Cause Doc™ is a growing functional and integrative health company seeking a motivated, personable, and highly organized Appointment Setter / Sales Follow-Up Specialist to join our team.



This is a client-facing sales support role and an important part of our prospective client experience. You will often be one of the first points of contact with our company, so we are looking for someone who communicates with warmth, professionalism, confidence, and exceptional attention to detail.



This is not a cold-calling position. Your primary focus will be following up with individuals who have already expressed interest in The Root Cause Doc™, including those who have purchased a Strategy Session and need assistance scheduling, rescheduling, or completing the necessary steps before their appointment.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team, with the opportunity for the position and hours to grow as our company continues to expand.



Schedule & Compensation

-Approximately 20 hours per week

-Current working hours are approximately 12:00 PM–4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday–Friday

-Potential for additional hours as the company grows

-$7.00 USD per hour

-Fully remote position

-Long-term opportunity



Key Responsibilities

-Follow up with individuals who have purchased a Strategy Session but have not yet scheduled their appointment

-Follow up with individuals who cancel their Strategy Session and assist with rescheduling when appropriate

-Contact individuals who do not show up for their scheduled Strategy Session to determine what happened and assist with rescheduling

-Follow up with individuals who have not completed their Roadmap questionnaire, which is required before attending their Strategy Session

-Make outbound follow-up calls to individuals who are already in our system and have expressed interest or purchased a Strategy Session — this is not cold calling

-Answer inbound calls related specifically to the Strategy Session and scheduling process, which may include:

    -Individuals returning a call after receiving outreach from you

    -Individuals who need to schedule, reschedule, cancel, or make a change to their Strategy Session

    -Individuals who are interested in getting started and want assistance scheduling a Strategy Session

-Communicate through phone, text message, and
 to help individuals move through the scheduling process

-Build rapport, answer basic questions, and help remove barriers that may be preventing someone from scheduling or attending their Strategy Session

-Track and identify trends and common reasons for cancellations, no-shows, incomplete Roadmaps, or failure to schedule

-Maintain consistent, timely, and professional follow-up

-Accurately document conversations, follow-up attempts, outcomes, and relevant information in GoHighLevel

-Work closely with our sales and administrative teams to improve appointment attendance and the overall prospective client experience

-Recognize recurring questions, concerns, or barriers and communicate those trends to the team

-Take ownership of assigned follow-up and make sure prospective clients do not unnecessarily fall through the cracks

-This role does not involve providing support to current program clients or handling general client-service calls. The phone responsibilities are focused on prospective clients, Strategy Sessions, and appointment scheduling.



What We’re Looking For

-Previous sales, appointment-setting, lead follow-up, or similar experience strongly preferred

-Excellent spoken and written English is required

-Strong verbal communication skills and a polished, professional phone presence

-Excellent grammar, spelling, and written communication skills

-Friendly, confident, genuine, compassionate, and professional

-Comfortable making follow-up calls and receiving scheduling-related inbound calls

-Comfortable communicating through phone, text, and
 throughout the workday

-Able to follow up consistently while maintaining a warm and professional approach

-Highly organized and able to manage multiple conversations and follow-up tasks

-Self-motivated and able to work independently

-Strong attention to detail

-Able to identify trends and communicate useful feedback to the team

-Reliable and responsive during scheduled working hours

-Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) is preferred

-Experience in healthcare, wellness, functional medicine, or a similar industry is a plus, but not required

-Must have a reliable computer, dependable high-speed internet connection, and an appropriate professional environment for making and receiving calls



About the Role

This position is about much more than sending appointment reminders.



You will be one of the first voices and points of contact representing The Root Cause Doc™ for many prospective clients. The way you communicate, follow up, and represent our company matters.



This is not a traditional cold-calling or lead-generation role. Much of your day will be spent following up with people who have already interacted with us but have not completed the next step — whether they purchased but never scheduled, canceled, missed their appointment, or have not completed their required Roadmap.



You may also speak with new prospective clients who contact us because they are interested in scheduling a Strategy Session and need assistance getting started.



We need someone who can build rapport, listen carefully, identify barriers, answer basic questions, and confidently guide people toward the appropriate next step.



We are looking for someone who is proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do. You should be able to recognize when something needs attention, take ownership of your responsibilities, and ask for clarification when needed.



Our Mission & Culture

Legacy Mission:



 Root Cause Medicine for Wholehearted Wellness

The Root Cause Doc™ exists to enhance the well-being of people by guiding them through an individualized and systematic approach to long-standing health concerns. Our goal is to help our clients experience greater energy, joy, resilience, and control over their health.



Our Team Core Values

-Independent Inquisitor

 Develop solutions, implement your ideas, think independently, and never be afraid to ask for help or clarification when you need it.

-Collaborative Candor

 Be honest and transparent in your communication, ideas, work, challenges, and successes. We believe in working together and celebrating each other’s wins.

-Invested Individual

 Have an owner-like mentality. Be invested in the outcome, resilient, willing to work quickly, and committed to getting things done.



Our Guiding Principles

At The Root Cause Doc™, we strive to:

-Be kind, genuine, and compassionate partners in care.

-Maintain exceptional attention to detail in everything we do.

-Continually expand our knowledge, skills, and comfort zones.

-Pursue excellence with efficiency — get it done, then continue improving.

-Work hard, work smart, and think bigger.

-Do the next thing now rather than unnecessarily putting it off.

-Be clear, straightforward, and transparent in our communication.

-Think like an owner and take pride in the quality of everything we put into the world.

-Remember that our work is about more than a paycheck and contributes to a larger mission.

-Keep our clients’ success at the center of what we do.

-Use questions and guidance to help empower people to think for themselves.

-Make thoughtful decisions using logic and available data rather than reacting emotionally.

-We value honesty, transparency, patient empowerment, collaboration, sovereignty, personal responsibility, and helping people become active participants in their own health.



How to Apply:

Along with your resume, please submit a short video introduction to 
 is an important part of our application process because this position involves significant phone and prospective-client communication.

In your video, please tell us:

-A little about yourself and your previous work experience

-Your experience with sales, appointment setting, lead follow-up, or customer service

-Whether you have experience using GoHighLevel (GHL) and, if so, what you have used it for

-Your experience handling follow-up calls and inbound scheduling calls

-The computer setup you will be using for this position

-Your internet speed and the reliability of your internet connection

-The specific hours you are available to work, including your time zone

-Whether you are consistently available during our current 12:00 PM–4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday–Friday schedule

-Whether you would be interested in additional hours as the position grows

-Why you are interested in a long-term position with The Root Cause Doc™

-Finally, after reviewing our mission, values, and guiding principles above, please tell us which core value or principle resonates with you the most and why.



We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership of their role, represent our company exceptionally well, and grow alongside our team for the long term.

title: Performance Video Editor (High Salary)
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–30 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewellery brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for traveller's, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.



This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.



We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.



You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.



It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.



Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.



What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.



Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.



Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.



APPLY HERE:

title: Junior Video Editor
description:
Basic Headline Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour to $10 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.
